metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I mean, it's such an interesting process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: So from the replica perspective, what do you think about translation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: How difficult it is to create a deep meaningful connection in Russian versus English?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: How you can translate the two languages?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: You speak both?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Yeah, I think we're two different people in different languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Even I'm thinking about, there's actually some research on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I looked into that at some point because I was fascinated by the fact that what I was

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: talking about with my Russian therapist has nothing to do with what I'm talking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: with my English speaking therapist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: It's two different lives, two different types of conversations, two different personas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: The main difference between the languages with Russian and English is that Russian,

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: well English is like a piano.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: It's a limited number of a lot of different keys, but not too many.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And Russian is like an organ or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: It's just something gigantic with so many different keys and so many different opportunities

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: to screw up and so many opportunities to do something completely tone deaf.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: It is just a much harder language to use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: It has way too much flexibility and way too many tones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: What about the entirety of World War II, communism, Stalin, the pain of the people having been

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: deceived by the dream?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: All the pain of just the entirety of it, is that in the language too?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Does that have to do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Oh, for sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I mean, we have words that don't have direct translation to English that are very much like

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: we have a bit of that, which is sort of like to hold a grudge or something, but you don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: need to have anyone to do it to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: It's just your state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: You just feel like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: You feel like betrayed by other people basically, but it's not that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And you can't really translate that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And I think it's super important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: There are very many words that are very specific, explain the Russian being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And I think it can only come from a nation that suffered so much and saw institutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: fall time after time after time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And what's exciting, maybe not exciting, exciting is the wrong word, but what's interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: about my generation, my mom's generation, my parents' generation, that we saw institutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: fall two or three times in our lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And most Americans have never seen them fall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And they just think that they exist forever, which is really interesting, but it's definitely

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: a country that suffered so much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And it makes, unfortunately, when I go back and I hang out with my Russian friends, it

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: makes people very cynical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: They stop believing in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I hope that's not going to be the case for so long or something's going to change again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: But I think seeing institutions fall is a very traumatic experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Makes it very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: And what's on 2020 is a very interesting...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Do you think civilization will collapse?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: See, I'm a very practical person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: We're speaking in English.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: So like you said, you're a different person in English and Russian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: So in Russian, you might answer that differently, but in English...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Well, I'm an optimist and I genuinely believe that there is all...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Even although the perspectives are green, there's always a place for a miracle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I mean, it's always been like that with my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: My life's been...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I've been incredibly lucky and things just...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Miracles happen all the time with this company, with people I know, with everything around

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: So I didn't mention that book, but it may be In Search for Miracles or In Search for

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Miracles or whatever the English translation for that is good Russian book for everyone

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: to read.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I mean, if you put good vibes, if you put love out there in the world, miracles somehow

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Yeah, I believe that too, or at least I believe that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Let me ask the most absurd, final, ridiculous question of...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: We talked about life a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: What do you think is the meaning of it all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: What's the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I mean, my answer is probably going to be pretty cheesy, but I think the state of love

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: is once you feel it in a way that we discussed before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I'm not talking about falling in love or...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: What's love?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: To yourself, to other people, to something, to the world, that state of bliss that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: experience sometimes, whether through connection with ourselves, with our people, with the

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: There's something special about those moments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: So I would say if anything, that's the only...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: If it's not for that, then for what else are we really trying to do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I don't think there's a better way to end it than talking about love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Eugenia, I told you offline that there was something about me that felt like this...

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: Talking to you, meeting you in person will be a turning point for my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I know that might sound weird to hear, but it was a huge honor to talk to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Eugenia Kuyda: Friendship with an AI Companion | Lex Fridman Podcast #121

body.input: I hope we talk again.

body.input: Let's start with an easy question.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: No jumping jacks?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Let's break that down into two questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I'm a human being, and like any human being,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I'm biologically programmed to be terrified of death.

body.input: Every physical element in our bodies

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is designed to keep us away from death.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I'm no different from anyone else in that regard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: If you throw me from the top of the Empire State Building,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I'm gonna scream all the way down to the concrete.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: the same way anyone else would.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So in that first sense of are you afraid of death,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: my body is terrified of injury leading to death

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: the same way any other human being would.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So when death is imminent, there's a terror

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that you would go through.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: because that's also an important point.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But if you look at the actual numbers of people there,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: they're actually pretty small.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So, ostensibly, if it comes down to a numbers game,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: America should dominate at the Olympics

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: because we have more wrestlers.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Now, the story gets more complicated

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: because America has a different style of wrestling,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: the collegiate style, than the international freestyle.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: That is a complicating factor.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But nonetheless, what you see there

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is that numbers aren't everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Rather, the manner in which people are trained

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: clearly has an impact.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And we know very little about the,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: there's very little reliable information

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: about the training program for wrestling

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: in the Russian states.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But one thing is incontestable

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is the amount of success that they've had

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: at an international world championship and Olympic competition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They are disproportionately successful,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: despite their relatively small numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There's nothing genetically special about them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You can talk about performance enhancing drugs,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but those are a worldwide phenomenon.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They don't have any access to technology

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that the rest of the world doesn't have.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: At some point, you've got to start asking,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: what are they doing differently in the training room?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And there are many other examples of similar situations.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: My country, New Zealand,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: has an insanely successful rugby program,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: the sport of rugby,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: which they have dominated for literally generations,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: despite the fact that our population is very, very small

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: compared with the rest of the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And we don't excel in many other sports.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: New Zealand does fairly well in sports overall,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but nothing like they do in rugby.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And you've got to ask yourself,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is there a culture there which built this up?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And the world is full of examples of seemingly small

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and unpromising areas or locations

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: putting out disproportionately high numbers

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: of successful athletes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And that points to the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that different training programs

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: have different success rates.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And so I truly believe with all my heart and all my soul

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that how you train does make a significant difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I would even go further and say it makes the most difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Is it the only thing? Absolutely not.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: We've already talked about fortune.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: We've talked about genetics.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: If you want to get nasty,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: you can even talk about things

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: like performance-enhancing drugs

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that obviously plays a role in modern sports.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But I do believe that the majority of what creates success

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is the interaction between the athlete

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and the training program.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Now, the training program is one thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I do believe that's the single most important,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but right behind it is the athlete themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: In my own experience,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: people talk about athletes that I've trained successfully,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but they never talk about athletes

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that I've trained under.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They never talk about athletes that I've trained unsuccessfully.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Always remember that for every champion a coach produces,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: there's a hundred people that they coach

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that no one ever heard of.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And this is completely normal.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: A coach can never take the lion's share of the credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: A coach creates possibilities,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but it's the athlete who actualizes the possibilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And so building that rapport

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and finding the right people to excel

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: in your training program is also a big part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: What makes the difference between the successful,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: your successes and your failures as a coach?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: A range of reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: The single most important is persistence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: People will point to all kinds of virtues amongst athletes.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: This guy's the most courageous.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: This guy's the strongest.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: These are all virtues,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but the one indispensable virtue is persistence.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: The ability just to stay in the game long enough

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: to get the results you seek.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But what does persistence really look like

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: if we can just break that apart a little bit?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: It's actually, this is a great question you're asking

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: because most people see it as a kind of simplistic doggedness

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: where you just show up every day.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: That's not it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: The most important form of persistence

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is persistence of thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: which looks to push you in increasingly efficient,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: more and more efficient methods of training.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Famously, people talk about the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that the hardest work of all is hard thinking,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and they're absolutely right.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Okay, coming into the gym and just doing the same thing

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: for a decade isn't going to make you better.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: What's going to make you better

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is progressive training over time

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: where you identify clear goals marked out in time increments,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: three months, six months, 12 months, five years,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and build those short-term goals

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: into a program of long-term goals,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: making sure that the training program changes over time

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: so that as your skill level rises,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: the challenges you face in the gym become higher and higher.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Don't kill them at the start with challenges

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that are too hard for them to deal with.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They get discouraged and leave.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Build them slowly over time,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but make sure they don't just get left in a swamp

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: where they're just doing the same thing

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: they were doing three years ago and they get bored.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There's two ways you can leave in a gym.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You can leave from adversity, it was too tough,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: or you can leave from boredom.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Everyone talks about the first.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: No one talks about the second.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Most people, when they get the black belt, they get bored.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They know what their game is.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They know what they're good at.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They know what they're not good at.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: When they compete, they stick with what they're good at

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and they avoid what they're not good at,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and they get bored.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They reach a plateau and that's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: My whole thing is to make sure it's not so tough

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: at the start that they leave because of adversity,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and then for the rest of their career

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: to make sure it's not boring

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: so they leave because of boredom.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Travis Deans actually said something

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that changed the way I see training.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: He said it as a side comment,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but he said that at the end of a training,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: this is the mid 1990s,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: the overall culture of the time saw leg locks as largely ineffective.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: We were told that against good opposition,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: they just didn't work very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They were low percentage techniques.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: We were also told that they were tactically unsound,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: because if you ever attempted them

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and you lost control of the leg lock,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: your opponent would end up on top of you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: or in some kind of good position

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and you'd be in terrible trouble.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And we were also told that they were unsafe,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that if they were applied in the gym,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: there'd be far too many injuries

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and people would be badly hurt.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: That was the received wisdom of that time.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I didn't even work with them at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: They would be shown occasionally in the gym

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and you'd learn them, you'd drill them, but inspiring,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I showed no interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You probably know that change when I met

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: the great American grappler, Dean Lester,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: who early in his career was using Achilles' Logs

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: with considerable success.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I met him in the gym, wonderful fellow.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Achilles' Logs is like a straight full log.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Yes, that's correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And he went on to become a heel hooker and win two ADCCs

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: later on in his career.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But we never met again after that.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And that opened some doors of inquiry.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Well, he asked this first principles question

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is why would you only use half the body in a game

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that involves the human body?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Perfect sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So that opened doors to inquiry.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And if you looked around the jiu-jitsu world at that time,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: the number of specialized leg lockers was very small.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And most of them were from outside

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: of conventional jiu-jitsu.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: For example, you could look around and see people

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: like Romina Sato had sharp leg locks

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: for that time period, the 1990s.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So they were out there, they existed.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And you'd see people like Ken Shamrock

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: would use heel hooks in competition

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and he had some good success with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: When I began experimenting in the gym, fairly soon,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: certain truths started to become evident.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And the most important of these can be understood

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: very quickly and they were relatively easy to discover.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: The first was that most people when they went to

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: understand and study leg locking,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and when I talk about leg locking,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I'm gonna talk about one specific type

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: which is the most high percentage type.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: This is leg locks which are performed with entanglements

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: of your opponent's legs with your legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There are other forms of leg lock,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but these are relatively low percentage

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and don't figure heavily in competition,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: so I'll ignore them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Most people made no distinction

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: between the mechanism of control

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: versus the mechanism of breaking.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: The heel hook is what ultimately breaks the ankle,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but the mechanism of control is the entanglement

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: of your legs to your opponent's legs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: The Japanese term ashigurami literally just means

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: like leg entanglement, it's a generic term.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: It could apply to any form of entanglement.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There are many options.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: My idea was let's focus on the entanglement first

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and worry about the breaking mechanism second.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: This was analogous to the idea of position before submission

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: only you couldn't talk about it

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: in terms of conventional positions

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: because ashigurami doesn't really fit

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: into the traditional hierarchies,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: positional hierarchies of jiu-jitsu.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So the conversation was switched from position to submission

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: to control to submission.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Now, wrapping two of your legs

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: around one of your opponent's legs

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: gives you many different options.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You can do it with your feet on the outside,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: so-called 50-50 variations.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You can do it with your feet on the inside

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and form what we call inside foot position.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There's pros and cons to both.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There's also methods of harmonizing the two.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So you have one foot on the inside

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and one foot on the outside.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You can do it with a straight leg

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: where you heel hook from the outside

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: or you can bring the leg across your center line

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and heel hook from the inside.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You will start to notice

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: as you work through these different variations

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that some present advantages over others.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: All of them come at a price to some degree,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: regardless of which ashigurami option you use.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There will be some degree of foot exposure

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: on my part to my opponent

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and some degree of back exposure

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: on my part relative to my opponent.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So that's the downside of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Variations within those different ashigurami

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: enable you to lessen danger in some respects

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and at the price of gaining dangers in others.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So you get this wide array of choices.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There's not this kind of simplistic hierarchy

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that you see in the basic positions of yudotsu,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but there are hierarchies.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I do, for example, generally favor inside heel hooks

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: over outside heel hooks.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: If I feel my opponent is very good at exposing my back

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: while I'm in ashigurami,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I generally prefer 50-50 situations.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: If I believe my opponent is very good at counter leg locks,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I generally prefer my feet on the inside,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: working with variations of insights and kaku, et cetera, et cetera.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: So there are broad heuristic rules

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that we can give to work in these situations.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Once you start to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: there's a variety of entanglements you can use,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: then you start getting to the really interesting ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: that as you perform one given attack, one given heel hook,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: you can flow through different forms of ashigurami

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: where you can create new dangers

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and avoid possible pitfalls in a very short timeframe

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: as you switch from one ashigurami to another over time

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: so that as your opponent's lines of resistance

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: to an initial attack change,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: you can accommodate those by switching

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: to another form of ashigurami

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: so that your mechanism of control

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is always pointing in opposite directions of his escape.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And if you focus on this idea of control through the legs,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: you can completely change the nature of leg locking

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and take it away from what it was in the 1990s,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: an opportunistic method of attack

body.input: to eke out a victory once they've done that.

body.input: They get a small tactical advantage,

body.input: they realize they're ahead, take no more risks

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and just do the minimum amount of work to get the victory.

body.input: Hodger's mindset was always to take

body.input: the riskier gambit of submission,

body.input: which entails a lot more work

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and in many cases a lot more skill.
