body.input: So that seems like a deeply human thing, the suicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Yes, that's a fascinating question in itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: If you look at the number of suicides per year,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: it's a shocking, shocking statistic that gets almost no recognition.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And yes, uniquely human, you don't, very, very few animals, you see,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: killing themselves because their whole thing is just survival.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And that humans, paradoxically, when survival is more or less guaranteed,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: are killing themselves in vast numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: It's usually linked back to the idea of meaning because it's so hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: It was hard to win the battle for survival,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but it's 10 times harder to win the battle for meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: When I think about it, first off, I'll say right from the bat,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: there's never going to be an agreed upon sense of meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: As I said, there was one thing that our physical bodies agreed upon,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: which is hardwired biologically into us, and that's survival.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But once we got to a more or less guaranteed survival, then all bets were off.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: At that point, you just have to start listing your own criteria.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And what one person will describe as a meaningful life,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: another person will decry as meaningless or wasted.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There's something terrible about the idea that we're sitting around,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: waiting for meaning to show up on our doorstep.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But what I find the best people do is they take charge of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and they look at their lives in a form of authorship

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: where they see their life as a tale to be written,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and they do their best to write that tale

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and put as much control over the direction of the story as they can.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: In the end, we all have to just try and write our own story.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: We all have our own interests.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I try to bring in the sense that even though I'm an atheist,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I don't believe that we go on to live after this.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I believe that there's a possibility of a God in an afterlife.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I don't say it's impossible,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: but in order for me to believe that they exist,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I'd have to see better evidence than I see currently.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Nonetheless, I do believe that there is a great value

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: in the idea of living for something bigger than yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: The moment you see yourself as the be-all and end-all of your existence,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: you're in for a meaningless life, and nothing will ever satisfy you.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You can have all the money in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You can have all the power in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: You'll be empty inside.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: I do believe that humans have a deep and abiding need

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: to follow the interests of a group bigger than themselves as an individual.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Is it ideal? No.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Is it an answer to the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: No, because eventually that group will itself die out.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: There's a sense in which it just plays a kind of delaying game.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: But I do believe that in order to live a happy life,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: meaning is a central part of that, and the deepest sense of meaning,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: not a fully complete answer, but a better answer than most people give,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: is to find something which hopefully does very little harm to the people around you

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and mostly benefits them, which enables you to become part of a community.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And to live, as I said, for something larger than you as an individual.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: If there is such a thing as a perfect conversation,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: it would be a conversation on death, meaning, and robots

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: with the great John Donahue, John Abinna Fan.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: It's a huge honor that you would waste all your time today.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Thank you so much for talking today.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: My pleasure. Thank you, Liggs.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation with John Donahue,

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and thank you to Onnit, Simply Safe, Indeed, and Linode.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Check them out in the description to support this podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: And now let me leave you some words from John Donahue himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: In fighting and competition, the objective is victory.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: In training, the objective is skill development.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Do not confuse them.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: As such, one of the best ways to train is to identify the strengths of your various partners

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: and regularly expose yourself to those strengths.

metadata.title: Podcast: John Danaher: The Path to Mastery in Jiu Jitsu, Grappling, Judo, and MMA | Lex Fridman Podcast #182

body.input: Thank you for listening and hope to see you next time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: In setting all this up, I talked to Joe Rogan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: who are at the top of their field,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: treat others as equals, as human beings,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: no matter who they are, even silly Russians in a suit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Meeting George was an honor for me beyond words.

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman Podcast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and here's my conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: with my long time martial arts hero,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and now my friend, Mr. George St. Pierre.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: In your fighting career,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: were you more motivated by the love of winning,

body.input: or the fear and hatred of losing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I like to win better than I hate to lose,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: because if it would not have been the case,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I would never have fought in the first place,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: because I don't like to fight at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But you talked about the anxiety,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: the fear, the experience leading up to a fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So to you, ultimately, the reason to go through that

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: difficult process is because it feels damn good

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: to have your hand raised?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: There is that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: There is also the fact that martial art

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: had been introduced when I was very young,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and it's probably the best thing I can do in my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Fighting, that's what I do best.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Also, it provides me of freedom,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: of access of things that most of people do not have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: but all that as a price.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And a lot of money,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I made a lot of money, of course, with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I was maybe predisposed with certain abilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I met incredible mentors throughout my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I worked really hard, and of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I had a lot of chances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: The stars were all aligned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And in order to keep those advantages

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: of freedom, money, and glory,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and access of things that most people don't have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and have this dream life that I have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I had to sacrifice myself and fight in order to keep it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It's very hard to understand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: because I also believe most fighters are not like me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: A lot of guys, because I corner a lot of guys,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and it seems to me that they love their job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: They enjoyed to go fight in a cage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I love to train.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I love the science of fighting, the sport,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: to be in good shape,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: the confidence that training in mixed martial art gives me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: However, I do not like the feeling of uncertainty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: the stress that I have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: not knowing if I will be badly injured,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: or humiliated, or winning the fight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It's, to me, unbearable,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and that's what takes the most out of me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: More than brain damage, more than anything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: that's what takes the most out of me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But the thing you get from it is the freedom that you get

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: because of the money, but because of the celebrity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: because of everything that comes with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So you can be the best version of yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: because of fighting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But at the same time, you've said that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: quote, I don't believe there's pleasure in life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I believe there's only a relief from pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: We have to suffer to be on top.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So isn't there something to just the suffering in itself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: just doing really difficult shit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: just to get to the top?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: To explain that, and so people can relate to it

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It preserves the magic of the silence of the private life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I think it can affect the development of the kid,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: if the kid grew up being, oh he's the son of that guy instead of being his own person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You know what I mean? So for me it's very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Like my parents are older, it's fine, but it taught me a big lesson.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: When I'm with my friend at the dinner or anything, I talk with the person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: always share a thing, but when I'm talking, I'm aware of the audience I'm in front.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Yeah, but oftentimes those people are just incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It kind of makes me sad that there's a lot of people that love you, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And there are a lot of really incredible people and you'll never get to really know their story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I don't know, for me it makes me sad. You see them at airports and stuff,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: people will tell me they listen to this podcast or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I can tell they're incredible people and it's like a little goodbye of a possible friend.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It makes me sad. It makes me lonely. It's almost like celebrity is a lonely thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So the higher the celebrity, the more lonely you become in some kind of way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But of course you have that little gem of a private life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Personally, I believe every relationship, I don't like to use this term,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: but it's always a give and take relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You can gain something and the person, it could be something not materialistic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: like something always a good, confident, someone that can give me good advice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It's a word I would say like extensional.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: If a pilot has a copilot, the copilot has an extensional relationship with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So he knows if he gets sick or he faint, he's there to make sure, he's there to help.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I think in every relation, it's about compatibility, but it's about extensionality, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: In a way that if that person is extensional.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And sometimes we talk about love, you know, like sometimes I think, is it a BS word or not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Because I myself sometimes look at myself in the mirror and when I do stupid thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: sometimes I love myself a lot and sometimes I don't. You know what I mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Because I'm angry at myself. I've done stupid thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: That means sometimes love could be fluctuating. You know what I mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: How about in relationship, sometimes people they say they love each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: but then when they divorce, they go, oh, I want the house and the dog and the kids stay with me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And you know what I mean? If you love, by definition, if you really love someone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and let's say you're an old man and you love a woman and she decide to leave you for a younger man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: If you really love her, you're going to help her pack and leave.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But in our society, sometimes we want to hone something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: To me, love includes the missing somebody, the losing somebody, the anger at somebody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It's all the passion, feelings towards somebody. That's all love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I, you know, it's all part of the thing. It's the ups and downs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It's the sad thing is when the feelings towards a person, the ups and downs go away, the forgetting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: That's the opposite of love. So the opposite of love isn't hate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: To me, the opposite of love is forgetting. And that's a much bigger, the depth of human connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: That's how I see love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So sometimes I try to stay positive and I've been asked how I try to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: because I have the image of someone who's positive, but I go through my own demon as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: However, we talk about love when I was young.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You know, like I didn't love who I was at first. That's how I love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I learned to kind of love myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Like I didn't, I didn't when I was going through bullying, I was, I believe I was bullied because I didn't love myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I, because I project a very bad image of what I think of myself. I was a kid that lacked a lot of confidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I was looking down when I was walking. I shrugged my shoulder.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: When someone was talking to me, I was avoiding eye contact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So I was a very easy target for bullies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I think bullies are like predatory animal in nature. They will hunt the easier prey.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: They would don't, they don't go, the lion don't go for the alpha bull.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: They go for the one who's hold or who's sick, the weakest one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And bullies are the same in society, I believe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I didn't like to be bullied, of course, but I didn't like the person that I was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But I found out through martial art, the respect and my coach was extraordinary to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: He taught me discipline and self-strength.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I found out that I needed to, in order to love myself, I needed to change myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Because I didn't, when I looked at myself in the mirror, I didn't like what I saw.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So I decided to become like someone that I would love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So I tried to look people straight up and trying to showcase a more confident image that I had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And it was hard in the beginning because I didn't really believe in it, but I faked it until kind of I make it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So when I was walking at school, more and more I was learning how to become more confident.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I was like taking charge, the teacher was asking questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: At first I was never answering, I was like this, waiting always to be the last.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Then I was, hey, I know what the answer, this is the answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I got out of my comfort zone, so to speak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I wish I would tell you that I got out of bullying because a Hollywood story, I used martial art to beat up all the bullies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But it's not how it happened to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It happened because I changed myself from the inside out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I learned how to, because I didn't love myself in the beginning, I learned how to become like someone that I love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And even now, like I'm by no mean perfect, I do a lot of stupid thing, but I learn as a person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And even I do have something stupid, I'm like, shoot, I did something stupid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: At least I can apologize to the person if I realize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I know that I'm not the person I was in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I'm the person that I am right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So I can learn and become that image of the person that I love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So in a way, the reason I'm trying to be positive and I'm able to stay positive sometime in life is because I'm always trying to be like that person that I love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I think if you don't look yourself in the mirror and don't love yourself or don't see any positive future for yourself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: how can you change your environment if you cannot change yourself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You know what I mean? You will never be happy if you're not happy when you look at yourself in the mirror.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So change yourself first, then change your, you know, it's not the environment that can change for yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You have to go from the inside out, you know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: This I learned through martial art. I had a coach who was incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: He used to drill these ideas in my head and give me confidence, you know, like this telling me all these beautiful things about myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And now he's dead now, unfortunately, peace to him. But he was incredible, incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: He was very, very strict. I was afraid of him. I was afraid of my dad and afraid of him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: He couldn't teach nowadays like he used to teach me because he would be probably in jail, you know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But I'm glad he did it because for the time being, that's what I needed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And I would never have had that career I had in mixed martial art without this

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: because I would never have got out of my comfort zone. It would have been impossible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And in order to improve in life, you need to get out of your comfort zone. It's hard, very hard to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And strive to be the person that you can love. That's beautifully put, George.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: If you were to give advice to a young person today about life, what would you tell him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: If he takes life with the same mentality that I do, if he has the same taste of things that I have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I would tell him, you know, for sport, for life in general, I would say, if you will have a dream,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: you know, like make everything in your power and work very hard, you know, never take no for an answer

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and go through hell in order to achieve it. Don't work hard only, but work smart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: That's, I think, the problems with a lot of people. They work hard. They can work hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: They burn themselves. They don't work smart, whether it is in science and business,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: they make bad choices or they're badly informed in sport. How many guys I've seen ruin their career in the gym?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: They spar so hard, they ruin themselves in the gyms. They leave their career in the gyms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: What I would say to, for example, because my field of expertise is in sport, of mixed martial art,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I would say to a young kid, make your training playful. You know, when you get ready for competition,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: you need to try to recreate those elements that make you go outside of your comfort zone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But in everyday life in general, make your training playful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Don't make it like a hardcore competition about who's winning, who's losing. Make it playful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So it will increase your... because you will not be afraid of getting hurt or losing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You will be tempted to try more things and it will make you become more creative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You know, that brings up another question about learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So you value knowledge and you're exceptional at basically being very good at learning and figuring stuff out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: New things or going deeper on the things you already know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So what advice would you have for how to learn effectively? How, you know, you say work smart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: How do you figure this game out?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I believe the best way to learn is learning from other people's mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: However, I'm not perfect and I've learned from my mistakes as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: And sometimes it took me a few mistakes to learn the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: But especially in the sport of mixed martial art, because we're talking about the failure,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: it could have very serious outcome on someone's life and well-being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: So it's crucial to try to learn from other people's mistakes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Do you study others?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Yes, every fight I've studied my opponent and I've studied myself as well to know what...

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: How my strength mix versus my opponent weaknesses and how can I make the fight go in a way that I'm taking my opponent outside of his comfort zone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Very often people are good at studying their opponent, but they're not good at looking at themselves in the mirror

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: and knowing what they should do in order to maximize their odds of success, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: That's why I always thought for me it was important to not be the best at one thing, but be very good at everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: That's why I always seek advice from the best in every discipline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Like I wrestle with the best wrestler I could be with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I box with the best boxers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I practice karate with the best karate fighters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Same thing in Jiu-Jitsu.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I train Jiu-Jitsu with the best Jiu-Jitsu guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: However, when I mix everything and mix martial art, because I'm very competent in every area,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: so when I'm fighting someone I'm very good at identifying where he's the less competent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I know for a fact that because I'm competent everywhere, if I can bring the fight where he's outside of his comfort zone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: it increases my odds of winning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: There's no certainty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It's all about odds, I believe, because there is always an X factor that you do not control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It's fascinating to see you actually because you've been a student of movement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You've been exploring all kinds of gymnastics, all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: There's something reminiscent to like Conor McGregor is one other martial artist that's kind of explored movement,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: been a scholar of movement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: At least from my perspective, it's very sort of Bruce Lee-like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: It's almost making a study of the human body and all the possible things you can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Is there a philosophy behind that that you have?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You talk about Bruce Lee, man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: You say that best. He changes my life too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: He was ahead of his time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: Yeah, incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: A lot of people talk to me and ask me, is Bruce Lee would have been able to fight in UFC?

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I don't think so. I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: I think he was a martial artist. He could have defended himself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: but to say that he could have competed amongst the elite fighter, perhaps in his time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Georges St-Pierre: The Science of Fighting | Lex Fridman Podcast #179

body.input: but for sure, if you put him in UFC right now, the sport has improved incredibly since then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I don't know if you have the same experience that every time I get on an airplane, it's incredible to me that human beings have actually been able to achieve this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And when I look at like what's happening now with humans traveling out into space, I see it as all the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's incredible that humans are able to get into a box and fly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: In the air and safely and land in the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It seems like and everybody's taking it for granted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So when I observe them, it's quite fascinating because I see that cleanly mapping to the world where we're now on in rockets and traveling to the moon, traveling to Mars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And at the same kind of way, I can already see the future where we will all take it for granted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So I don't know. I don't know if you have you personally when you fly have the same kind of magical experience of like how the heck that humans actually accomplish this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So I do, especially when there's turbulence, which is, you know, like on the way here, there was turbulence and the plane jiggled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Even the flight attendant had to hold on to the side and I was just thinking to myself, it's amazing that this happens all the time and the wings don't fall off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You know, like given how many planes are flying, but then I often think about it and I'm like, you know, a long time ago, I think people didn't trust elevators in a 40 story building in New York City.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And now we just take it completely for granted that you can step into this shaft, which is 40 floors up and down and it will just not fail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, again, I'm the same way with elevators, but also buildings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I'll stand on the 40th floor and wonder how the heck are we not falling right now?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Like how amazing it is with the high winds, like structurally, just the earthquakes and the vibrations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I mean, natural vibrations in the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Like how is this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I mean, to me, one of the most beautiful things actually mathematically too, is Bridges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I used to build bridges in high school from like toothpicks, just like out of the pure joy of like physics, making some structure really strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then you see that at scale, humans being able to span a body of water with a single bridge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Being able to span a body of water with a giant bridge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And it's, I don't know, it's so humbling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It makes you realize how dependent we are on each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Sort of, I talk about love a lot, but there's a certain element in which we little ants have just a small amount of knowledge about our particular thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then we're depending on a network of knowledge that other experts hold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then most of our lives, most of the quality of life we have has to do with the richness of that network of knowledge, of that collaboration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then sort of the ability to build on top of it, levels of abstractions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You start from like bits in a computer, then you can have assembly, then you can have C++.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which makes it hard to control the disease

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: because then the people you're trying to control keep getting other people sick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You can see already how I'm thinking and talking about this feedback loops.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This is actually related to something you said earlier

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: about even like how skyscrapers stay in the air.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The whole point is control theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You actually want to or even how an airplane stays.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You need to have control loops which are feedbacking in the right way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And what we observed was that the feedback control loop

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: for controlling disease by asking people to be removed from society

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: against their will was not working.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It was running against human incentives,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and you suddenly are trying to control seven billion, eight billion people

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: in ways that they don't individually want to necessarily do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So here's the idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And this is inspired by the fact that at the core of our team

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: were user experience designers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's actually, in fact, the first thing I knew we needed when we started

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: was to bring user experience at the core.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But so the idea was, suppose hypothetically there was a pandemic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: What would you want?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You would want a way to be able to live your life as much as possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and avoid getting sick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Can we make an app to help you avoid getting sick?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Notice how I've just articulated the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It is not can we make an app so that after you are around somebody who's sick,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you can be removed from society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's can we make an app so that you can avoid getting sick?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That would run a positive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I don't know if I want to call it positive or negative,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: but it would run a good feedback loop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So then how would you do this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The only problem is that you don't know who's sick because especially with this

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: disease, if I see somebody who looks perfectly healthy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: the disease spreads two days before you have any symptoms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And so it's actually not possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's where the network theory comes in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You caught it from someone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: What if we change the paradigm and we said whenever there's a sickness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: tell everybody how many physical relationships separate them from the sickness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That is the trivial idea we added.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The trivial idea was the distance between you and a disease is not measured in feet

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: or seconds, it's measured in terms of how many close physical relationships

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: separate you, like these six degrees of separation like LinkedIn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Simple idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: What if we told everyone that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It turns out that actually unlocks some interesting behavioral feedback loops,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which, for example, let me now jump to a non-COVID example to show why this maybe

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: could be useful. Actually, we think it could be quite useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Imagine there was Ebola or some hemorrhagic fever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Imagine it spread through contact, through the air, in fact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Pretend.

body.input: That's a disastrous disease.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It has high fatality rate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And as you die, you're bleeding out of every orifice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, not pleasant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Not pleasant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the question is, suppose that such a disease broke.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Who would want to install an app that would tell them how many relationships

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: away from them this disease had struck?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: A lot of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: A lot of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: In fact, I don't want to say almost everyone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's a very strong statement, but a very large number of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's fascinating framing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The more deadly and transmissible the disease, the stronger the incentive to install it

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: in a positive sense, in the good feedback loop sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's a really good example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's a really good way to frame it, because with COVID, it was not as deadly

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: as potential pandemics could have been, viruses could have been.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So it's sometimes muddled with how we think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But yeah, this is a really good framing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If the virus was a lot more deadly, you want to create a system that has a set

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: of incentives that it quickly spreads to the population where everybody is using it

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and is contributing in a positive way to the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And actually, that point you just made, I don't take credit for that observation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: There was another person I talked to who pointed out that it's very interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: that this feedback loop is even more effective when the disease is worse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And that's actually not a bad characteristic to have in your feedback loop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you're trying to help civilization keep running.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, it's a really dynamic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Like people figure out, they dynamically figure out how bad the disease is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The more it spreads and the deadlier it is as the people observe it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: as long as the spread of information, like semantic information,

body.input: natural language information is closely aligned with the reality of the disease,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which is a whole nother conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Maybe we'll chat about that, how we sort of make sure there's not misinformation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: whether there's accurate information, but that aside, OK, so this is a really nice property.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Right. And just going on on that, actually just talking more about what that could do

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and why we're so excited about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's that not only would people want to install it, what would they do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you start to see that this disease is getting closer and closer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But now you notice what this has just achieved.

body.input: The whole goal on this whole exercise was you got the people who might be sick

body.input: and you got everyone else, set A and set B.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Set A is the people who might be sick, set B is everyone else.

body.input: And for the entirety of the past, contact tracing approaches,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You can also let the people at set B, at the fringe of set A,

body.input: attempt to remove themselves from this interface.
