body.input: It's the symmetry of A and B separation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Everyone was looking at A, we look at B, and suddenly B is in their incentive to do so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Beautiful. So there's a virus that jumps from human to human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So there's a network, sometimes called graph, of the spread of a virus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It hops from person to person to person to person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And each one of us individuals are sitting or plopped into that network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: We have close friends and relations and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's kind of fascinating to actually think about this network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And we can maybe talk about the shapes of this kind of network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I was trying to think exactly this, like, how many people do I,

body.input: I'm kind of an introvert, not kind of, I'm very much an introvert.

body.input: There is a kind of network of and there's maybe in the graph,

body.input: the erratic sense, there's some weights or something about how

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: close that relationship is in terms of the frequency of visits,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: the duration of visits and all of those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So you're saying we might want to be to create on top of that network,

body.input: how close is it getting to you?

body.input: And the number of hops away it is on that network is really powerful

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: information that creates a positive feedback loop where you can act

body.input: essentially anonymously and on your own.

body.input: Like nobody's telling you what to do, which is really important, is decentralized

body.input: and not whatever the opposite of authoritarian is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: computer programming competitions and Math Olympiads.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: In fact, our team that was working on the algorithm and backend side

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: included several people who had been in these competitions from before,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which I happen to know because I do coach the team for the math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And so we were able to bring people in to build servers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: a server infrastructure in C++, actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: so that we could support significant numbers of people without needing tons of servers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Is there some distributed algorithms working here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: or you basically have to keep in the same place the entire graph as it builds?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Because especially the more and more people use it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: the bigger the bigger the graph gets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I mean, this is very difficult scaling problem, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Ah, so that's actually why this computer algorithm competition stuff was handy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's because there are only about seven to eight giga people in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's not that many.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So if you can make your algorithms linear time or almost linear time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: a computer operates in gigahertz.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I only need to do one run, one recalculation every hour

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: in terms of telling people how far away these dangers are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So I suddenly have 3600 seconds,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and my CPU cores are running in gigahertz,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and at most they're eight giga people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Well, you're skipping over the fact that there's N squared potential connections between people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So how do you get around the fact that the potential set of relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: any one of us could have is eight billion, so it's eight billion times squared.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's the potential amount of data you have to be storing and computing over and constantly updating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the way we dealt with that is we actually expect that the typical network is very sparse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The technical term sparse would mean that the average degree

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: or the average number of connections that a person has

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: is going to be at most like 100 strong connections that you care about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you think of it almost in terms of the heavy hitters,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: actually in most people's lives,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: if we just kept track of their top 100 interactions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: that's probably most of the signal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I'm saddened to think that I might not be even in a double digits, but...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Oh, I was intentionally giving a crazy number to account for college students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Oh, those are who you call the heavy hitters, the people who are like the social butterflies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I need to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I'd love to know that information about myself, by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Do you expose the graph?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Like how many...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Like about yourself, how many connections you have?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: We do expose to each person how many direct connections they have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But for privacy purposes, we don't tell anybody who their connections are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: How their connections are interconnected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes, gotcha.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But at the same time, we do expose also to everyone an interesting chart that says,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: here's how many people you have that you're connected to directly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Here's how many at distance two, meaning via people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then here's how many at distance three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And the reason we do that is that actually ends up being a dynamic

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: that also boosts adoption, drives another feedback loop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The reason is because we saw actually when we deployed this in some universities

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: that when people see on their app that they are indirectly connected to hundreds

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: or thousands of other people, they get excited and they tell other people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: hey, let's download this app.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But we also saw in those examples, especially looking at the screenshots people gave,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: that is hit as soon as the typical person has two or three other direct connections on the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Because that means that our app has reached a virality or not of two to three.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The key is we were making a viral app to fight a virus

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: spreading on the same network that the virus spreads out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So you're trying to out virus the virus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's exactly right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: OK, great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: What have you learned from this whole experience in terms of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: let's say for COVID, but for future pandemics as well?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Is it possible to use the power information here of networked information

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: as the virus spreads and travels in order to basically keep the society open?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Is it possible for people to protect themselves with this information?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Or do you still have to have most like in this overarching policy of everybody should stay at home?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: All that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: We are trying to answer that question right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the answer is we don't know yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But that's actually why we're very happy that now the idea has started to become more widely known.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And we're already starting to collaborate with epidemiologists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Again, I'm just a mathematician, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And a mathematician should not be the person who is telling everybody this will definitely work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But because of the potential power of this approach,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: especially the potential power of this being an end game for COVID,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: we have gotten the interest of real researchers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And we're now working together to try to actually understand the answer to that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Because you see, there's a theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So what I can share is the mathematics of here's why there's some hope that this would work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And that's because I'm talking about end game now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: End game means you have very few cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But everywhere we're always thinking once there's few cases, then does that mean we now open up?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Once you open up in the past, then the cases go up again until you have to lock down again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And now when we talk about the dynamic process that makes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: it's guaranteeing you always have cases until you have the great vaccines,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which is, you know, we both got vaccinated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This is good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But at the same time, why I'm thinking this is still important is because we know that many vaccine makers

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: have said they're preparing for the next dose next year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And if we have a perpetual thing where you just always need a new vaccine every year,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: it could actually be beneficial to make sure we have as many other techniques as possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: for parts of the world that can't afford, for example, that kind of distribution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, so actually, no matter how deadly the virus is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: no matter how many things, whether you have a vaccine or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: it's still useful to be having this information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Is to stay home or not, depending on how risk...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I'm a big fan, just like you said, of having the freedom for you to decide how risk averse you want to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Depending on your own conditions, but also on the state of like what you...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: just how dangerously you like to live.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So I think that actually makes a lot of sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And I also think that since we're...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: when you think of disease spreading, it spreads in aggregate in the sense that

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: if there are some people who maybe are more risk tolerant because of other things in their life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: well, there might also be other people who are less risk tolerant,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and then those people decide to isolate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But what matters is in the aggregate that this R naught of the infection spreading drops below one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And so the key is if you can empower people with that power to make that decision,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you might actually still be able to drive that R naught down below one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah. And also, this is me talking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I... people get a little bit nervous, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: with information somehow mapping to privacy violation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But first of all, in the approach you're describing, that's respecting anonymity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But I would love to have information from the very beginning, from March and April of last year,

body.input: almost like a map of like where it's risky and where it's not to go,

body.input: Just...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and maybe not necessarily about actual location, but just maybe activities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Like just to have information about what is good to do and not, you know, in terms of like safety.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And the scientists themselves also, very important, don't always know what they're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Epidemiology is not...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: is as much an art as a science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You're desperately trying to predict the future, which nobody can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then you're trying to speak with some level of authority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I mean, if I were to criticize scientists, they spoke with too much authority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's OK to say, I'm not sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But then they think like, if I say I'm not sure, then there's going to be distrust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: What they realize is when you're wrong and you say I'm sure, it's going to lead to more distrust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So there's this imperfect, like just chaotic, messy system of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: trying to figure out with very little information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And what you're proposing is just a huge amount of information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And information is power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Is there challenges with adoption that you see in the future here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So there's maybe we could speak to there's approaches, I guess, from Google.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: There's different people have tried similar kind of ideas, not in...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you have quite a novel idea, actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But speaking the umbrella idea of contact tracing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Is there...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: is there something you can comment about why their approaches haven't been fully adopted?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Is there challenges there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Is there is there reasons why Novid might be a better idea moving forward

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and in general, just about adoption?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, so first of all, I want to say I always have respect for the methods that other people use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And so it's good to see the other people have been trying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But what we have noticed is that the difference between our value proposition to the user

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and the value proposition to the user delivered by everything that was made before

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: is that unfortunately, the action of installing a standard contact tracing app

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: will then tell you after you've already been exposed to the disease

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: so that you can protect other people from you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And what that does to your own direct probability of getting sick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you think about it, suppose you were making the decision,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: should I or should I not install one of those apps?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: What does that do to your own probability of getting sick?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's close to zero.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This is the sad thing you're speaking to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Not sad, I suppose, it's the way of the world is

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: the only incentive there is to just help other people, I suppose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But a much stronger incentive is anything that allows you to help yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes. So what I'm saying is that, let's just say free market capitalism was not based on altruism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I think it's based on if you make a system of incentives

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: so that everybody trying to maximize their own situation somehow contributes to the whole,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: that's a game theoretic solution to a very hard problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And so this is actually basically mechanism design.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: We've basically come up with a different mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: different set of incentives, which incentivizes the adoption.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Because actually, whenever we've been rolling it out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: usually the first question we ask people, like say in a university is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: do you know what Novit does?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And most of them have read about the other apps and they say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: oh, Novit will tell you after you've been around someone so you can quarantine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And we have to explain to them, actually Novit never wants to ask you to quarantine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's not the principle. Our principle isn't based on that at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: We just want to let you know if something is coming close

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: so that you can protect yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you want, if you want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then the quarantine is like, yes, in that case, if you're quarantining,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: it's because you're shutting the door from the inside, if that makes sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I mean, this is brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So what do you think the future looks like for future pandemics?

body.input: So the biggest work I'm working on right now

body.input: That's the goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's actually ongoing work right now.

body.input: And so, for example, if anyone's watching this

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and you want to be involved in something like this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I'm just going to say I'm still incentive thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: There is something in it for the researchers, too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This could open up an entire new way of controlling disease.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's my hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I mean, it might actually be true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And people who are involved in figuring out how to make this work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: well, it could actually be good for their careers, too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Oh, so you mean like from a research perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Anybody could be the next, I don't know, Hemingway, James Joyce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And so you're forcing an education on the populace and a rigorous, deep education,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: like as opposed to kind of like, oh, we want to make sure we

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: teach to the weakest student in the class, which American systems can sometimes do

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: because we don't want to leave anyone behind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The Russian system was anyone can be the strongest student and we're going to teach

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you the strongest student and we're going to pretend or force everybody, even the

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: weakest student, to be strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And what that results in, it's obviously this is what people talk about is a huge

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: amount of pressure, like it's psychologically very difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This is why people struggle when they go to MIT.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This very competitive environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It can be very psychologically difficult, but at the same time, it's bringing out

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: the best out of people and that mathematics was certainly one of those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And exactly what you're saying, which kind of clicked with me just now, as opposed

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: to kind of spelling bee in the United States, which I guess you spell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I'm horrible at this, but it's a competition about spelling, which I'm not sure, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you could argue doesn't generalize well to the future skills.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Mathematics, especially this kind of mathematics, is essentially a formalized

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: competition of invention, of

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: of creating new ideas, and that generalizes really, really well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So that's quite brilliantly put.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I didn't really think about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So this is not just about the competition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This is about developing minds that will come to do some incredible stuff in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, actually, I want to respond to a couple of things there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The first one is one which is this notion of whether or not that is possible in a

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: non-authoritarian regime. I think it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And that's actually why I spent some of my efforts before the COVID thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: actually trying to work towards there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The reason is because if you think about it, let's say in America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: lots of people are pretty serious about training very hard for football or

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: baseball or basketball. Basketball is very, very accessible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But lots of people are doing that. Why?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Well, actually, I think that what was going on with the authoritarian thing was

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: at least the message that was universally sent was being a good thinker and a creator of ideas is a good thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: There's no reason why that message can't be sent everywhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And I think it actually should be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So that's the first thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The second thing is what you commented about this thing about the generalizable skill

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and what could people do with Olympiads afterwards.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So that's actually my interest in the whole thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I don't just coach students how to do problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: In fact, I'm not even the best person for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I'm not the best at solving these problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: There are other people who are much better at making problems and teaching people how to solve problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: In fact, when I was when the Mathematical Association of America, which is the group

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which is in charge of the US participation in these Olympiads, when they were deciding

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: whether or not to put me in back in 2013 as the head coach, I had a conversation with

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: their executive director where I commented that we might do worse because my position was I don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I mean, I actually didn't want to focus on winning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I said, if you're going to let me work with 60 very strong minds as picked

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: through this system because the coach works with these, gets to run a camp for these students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I said, I'm actually not going to define my success in terms of winning this contest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I said I wanted to maximize the number of the students that I read about in the New York Times in 20 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And the executive director of the Mathematical Association of America was fully in support of this

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: because that's also how their philosophy is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So in America, the way we run this is we're actually not just training to win, even though

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: the students are very good and they can win anyway.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: One reason, for example, I went and even did the COVID thing involving quite a few of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's so that hopefully some of them get ideas because in 20, 30 years, I won't have the energy

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: or the insight to solve problems, we'll have another catastrophe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And hopefully some of these people will step up and do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And ultimately have that long term impact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I wonder if this is scalable to, because that's such a great metric for education,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: not how to get an A on the test,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: but how to be on the cover of New York Times for inventing something new.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Do you think that's generalizable to education beyond just this particular Olympiad?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Like, even you saying this feels like a rare statement, almost like a radical statement

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: as a goal for education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So actually the way I teach my classes at Carnegie Mellon, which I will admit right away

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: is not equivalent to the average in the world, but it's already not just the top 60 in the country

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: as picked by something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Let me just explain, I have exams in my class, which are 90% of the grade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the exams are the whole thing, or most of the whole thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And the way that I let students prepare for the exams is I show them all the problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I've ever given on the previous exams.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And the exam that they will take is open notes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: They can take all the notes they want on the previous problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And the guarantee is that the exam problems this time will have no overlap

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: with anything you've seen me give in the past,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: as well as no overlap with anything I taught in the class.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the entire exam is invention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Wow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But that's how I go, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: My point is I have explained to people when I teach you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I don't want you to have remembered a math that I showed you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: I want you to have learned enough about this area that if you face a new question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which I came up with the night before by thinking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: like, what could I ask that I have never asked before?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Oh, that's cute. I wonder what the answer is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Aha, that's an exam problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's exactly what I do before the exam.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then that's what I want them to learn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And the first exam, usually people have a rough time because it's like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: what kind of crazy class is this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The professor doesn't teach you anything for the exam.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But then by the second or third, and by the time they finish the class,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: they have learned how to solve anything in the area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: How to invent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: How to invent in that area, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Can we walk back to the Mathematical Olympiad?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: What's the scoring and format like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And also, what does it take to win?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the way it works is that each of the six students do the problems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and there are six problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: All the problems are equally weighted, so each one's worth seven points.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That means that your maximum score is six problems times seven points,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which is the nice number of 42.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And now the way that they're scored, by the way, is there's partial credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the question's asking you, explain why this weird fact is true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: OK, if you explain why, you get seven points.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you make minor mistake, maybe you get six points.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But if you don't succeed in explaining why,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: but you explain some other true fact, which is along the way of proving it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: then you get partial credit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And actually, now this is tricky, because how do you score such a thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's not like the answer was 72 and you wrote 71, and it's close, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The answer is 72 and you wrote 36.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Oh, but that's pretty close because you were...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Maybe you were just off by a bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: By the way, they're not numerical anyway,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: but I'm just giving some numerical analogue to the way the scoring might work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: They are all essays.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And that's where I guess I have some role,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: as well as some other people who helped me in the US delegation for coaches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: We actually debate with the country which is organising it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The country which is organising the Olympiad brings about 50 people

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: to help judge the written solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And you schedule these half hour appointments

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: where the delegation from one country sits down at a table like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Opposite side is two or three people from the host country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And they're just looking over these exam papers saying,

body.input: Actually, I think it's still...

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It doesn't need to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It doesn't need to.
