body.input: It can be beautiful and it's all right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, so the easiest way to describe this is suppose you got like a big crowd of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and everybody knows how many hours of sleep they got last night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And you want to know how many total hours of sleep were gotten by this big crowd of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: At the beginning, you might say that sounds like a linear time algorithm of saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: hey, how many hours you got?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: How many you got?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: How many you got?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Add, add, add.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But there's a way to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you remember that there are people and they presumably know how to add,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you could make a distributed algorithm to make this happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: For example, while we're thinking of these trees, imagine you had 1,024 people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: If you could just say, hey, person number one and person number two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you will add your hours of sleep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Person number two will go away and person number one is going to remember the sum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Person three and four add up and person three takes charge of remembering it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Person four goes away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Now this like person one knows the sum of these two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Person three knows the sum of those two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: They talk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You see what I mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's like you're going up this tree, same tree that we talked about earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Build up a tree from the bottom up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, build up a tree from the bottom up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And the beautiful thing is since everyone's doing stuff in parallel,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: the amount of time it takes to get the total sum is actually just the number of layers in the tree,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which is 10.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So now that's logarithmic time to add up the number of hours that people slept today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Sounds fantastic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: There's only one problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: How do you decide who's person number one and person number two?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So if, for example, we just went out into downtown and said, hey, get these thousand people, go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Well, if you're going to go and say, and by the way, you're one and you're two

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: and you're three, that's linear time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That's cheating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So now the question is how to do this in a distributed way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And there were some people who proposed a very elegant algorithm and they wanted to analyze it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So I came in onto the analyze side, but the elegant algorithm was like this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It was like, well, we don't actually know what this big tree is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: There isn't any big tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So what's going to happen is first, everyone is going to decide right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Oh, what an important thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Everyone is going to, at the very beginning of the whole game,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: they will have delegated responsibility to themselves as the one who knows the sum so far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the point is there's going to be, people are all going to have like a pointer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: which says, you are the one who knows my, you've taken care of my ticket, my number.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yeah, they select the representative for this particular piece of knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And at the very beginning, you're your own representative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The thing has to start simple.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So at the beginning, you're on the represent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You're pointing to yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Got it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yep.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And now the way this works is that at every time step, someone blares a ding dong on the town clock or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And each person flips a coin themselves to decide, am I going to hunt for somebody to give my number to and let them represent me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Or am I going to sit here and wait for someone to come?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Well, they flip their coin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Some of the people start asking other people saying, hey, I would like you to be my representative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Here is my number.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But the problem is that there's limited bandwidth of the people who are getting asked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's like you can't get, you can't go out to prom with five people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That is not what we're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: We're adding numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But you can only add one number.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the person who has suddenly gotten asked by all these people, well, they'll have to decide who they're going to take it from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And they randomly just choose one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: When they randomly choose one, all the others are rejected and they don't get to delegate anything in that round.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But now if this person has absorbed this one who said, okay, here, you take charge of my number, this person now updates their pointer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You're in charge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And this person adds the two numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That was the first round.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: In the next round, when they do the coin flipping, this person doesn't flip anymore because they're just delegating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's that anyone who has the pointers themselves, that's like a person who is in charge of some number of information,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: they flip the coin to decide, should I find other people who are agents or should I wait for people to ask me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Brilliant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This is somebody else's idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And then now the idea is, okay, if you just keep doing this process, what ends up happening?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Oh yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And also, by the way, if you decide that you want to go reach out to other people, here's the catch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: When you're one of these agents saying, okay, I'm going to go look for someone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you have no idea who in this crowd is an agent or somebody who delegated it to someone else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You just pick a random person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: When you pick the random person, if it lands on someone and the person says, oh, I actually delegated it to someone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: then you follow the point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: You walk up the delegation chain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Walk up delegation chain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And you can do like path compression in the algorithm to make it so you don't consistently do lots of walking up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But the bottom line is that what ends up happening is that you end up reaching out whenever you're one of the ones reaching out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: you can think of it as each agent is responsible for some number of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: It's almost like they're the leader of a bunch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: As the process is evolving, you have these lumps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Each lump has an agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And when the agent reaches out, they reach out to another lump where the probability of them hitting that lump is proportional to the size of the lump.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That is the one funny thing about this process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: This is not that they can reach out to a uniformly random lump where every lump has the same chance of getting reached out to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The bigger the lump is, the more likely it is that you end up reaching that lump.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Which is a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Let me explain why that's a problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Because you see, you're hoping that this has a small number of steps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But here's a bad situation that could happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Imagine if you had like, there are N people that you're adding up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Imagine that you have exactly square root of N lumps left, of which almost all of them are just one person who's still their own boss, their own manager.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And now you suddenly have time, which is about square root of N.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: The square root of N is chosen because that is one where the lumps are such that you really are limited by this large one slowly sucking up the rest of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: So the heart of the question became, well, but is that just so unusual that it doesn't usually happen?

body.input: Because remember you start with everyone just being independent.

body.input: It's like a lot of lumps of size one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: How naturally do the big lumps emerge?

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: And so what that heart of the proof was, was showing that that was a joint work with A.L. Lebetsky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: That one was showing that actually in that thing, the lumps do kind of get out of whack.

body.input: And so it is not the purely logarithmic number of steps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Po-Shen Loh: Mathematics, Math Olympiad, Combinatorics & Contact Tracing | Lex Fridman Podcast #183

body.input: But if you make one very slight change, which is if you are one of the agents and you have just been propositioned, possibly relayed along by a couple of different people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So it was an honor for me to have this conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: as part of MIT course in artificial general intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and the artificial intelligence podcast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: If you enjoy it, please subscribe on YouTube, iTunes

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: or your podcast provider of choice

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: or simply connect with me on Twitter at Lex Friedman

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: spelled F-R-I-D.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And now here's my conversation with Stuart Russell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So you've mentioned in 1975 in high school,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you've created one of your first AI programs

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that played chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Were you ever able to build a program that beat you

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: at chess or another board game?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So my program never beat me at chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: I actually wrote the program at Imperial College.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So I used to take the bus every Wednesday

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: with a box of cards this big

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and shove them into the card reader

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and they gave us eight seconds of CPU time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: It took about five seconds to read the cards in

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and compile the code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So we had three seconds of CPU time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: which was enough to make one move.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: You know, with a not very deep search.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And then we would print that move out

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and then we'd have to go to the back of the queue

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and wait to feed the cards in again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: How deep was the search?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Are we talking about one move, two moves, three moves?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So no, I think we got an eight move,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you know, a depth eight with alpha beta

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and we had some tricks of our own about move ordering

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and some pruning of the tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: But you were still able to beat that program?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: I was a reasonable chess player in my youth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: I did an Othello program and a backgammon program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So when I got to Berkeley, I worked a lot on

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: what we call meta reasoning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: which really means reasoning about reasoning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And in the case of a game playing program,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you need to reason about what parts of the search tree

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you're actually going to explore

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: because the search tree is enormous

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: or bigger than the number of atoms in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And the way programs succeed and the way humans succeed

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: is by only looking at a small fraction of the search tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And if you look at the right fraction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you play really well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: If you look at the wrong fraction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: if you waste your time thinking about things

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that are never gonna happen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: the moves that no one's ever gonna make,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: then you're gonna lose

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: because you won't be able to figure out the right decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So that question of how to do it

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and how machines can manage their own computation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: how they decide what to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: is the meta reasoning question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And we developed some methods for doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And very simply, a machine should think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: whatever thoughts are going to improve its decision quality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: We were able to show that both for Othello,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: which is a standard two-player game,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and for backgammon, which includes dice rolls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So it's a two-player game with uncertainty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: For both of those cases, we could come up with algorithms

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that were actually much more efficient

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: than the standard alpha beta search,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: which chess programs at the time were using.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And those programs could beat me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And I think you can see the same basic ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: in AlphaGo and AlphaZero today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: The way they explore the tree is using

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: a form of meta reasoning to select what to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: based on how useful it is to think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Is there any insights you can describe

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: without Greek symbols of how do we select

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: which paths to go down?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: There's really two kinds of learning going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So as you say, AlphaGo learns to evaluate board positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So it can look at a go board and it actually has

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: probably a superhuman ability to instantly tell

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: how promising that situation is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: To me, the amazing thing about AlphaGo is not that

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: it can be the world champion

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: with its hands tied behind its back,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: but the fact that if you stop it from searching altogether,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: so you say, okay, you're not allowed to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: any thinking ahead, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: You can just consider each of your legal moves

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and then look at the resulting situation and evaluate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So what we call a depth one search.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So just the immediate outcome of your moves

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and decide if that's good or bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: That version of AlphaGo

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: can still play at a professional level, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And human professionals are sitting there

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: for five, 10 minutes deciding what to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and AlphaGo in less than a second can instantly intuit

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: what is the right move to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: based on its ability to evaluate positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And that is remarkable because we don't have that level

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: of intuition about go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: We actually have to think about the situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So anyway, that capability that AlphaGo has

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: is one big part of why it beats humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: The other big part is that it's able to look ahead

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: 40, 50, 60 moves into the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And if it was considering all possibilities

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: 40 or 50 or 60 moves into the future,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that would be 10 to the 200 possibilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So way more than atoms in the universe and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So it's very, very selective about what it looks at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So let me try to give you an intuition

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: about how you decide what to think about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: It's a combination of two things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: One is how promising it is, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So if you're already convinced that a move is terrible,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: there's no point spending a lot more time convincing yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that it's terrible

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: because it's probably not gonna change your mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So the real reason you think is because there's some

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: possibility of changing your mind about what to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And is that changing your mind that would result then

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: in a better final action in the real world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So that's the purpose of thinking is to improve

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: the final action in the real world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And so if you think about a move that is guaranteed

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: to be terrible, you can convince yourself it's terrible,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you're still not gonna change your mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: But on the other hand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you're supposed you had a choice between two moves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: One of them you've already figured out is guaranteed

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: to be a draw, let's say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And then the other one looks a little bit worse.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Like it looks fairly likely that if you make that move,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you're gonna lose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: But there's still some uncertainty

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: about the value of that move.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: There's still some possibility that it will turn out

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: to be a win, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Then it's worth thinking about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So even though it's less promising on average

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: than the other move, which is guaranteed to be a draw,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: there's still some purpose in thinking about it

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: because there's a chance that you will change your mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and discover that in fact it's a better move.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So it's a combination of how good the move appears to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and how much uncertainty there is about its value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: The more uncertainty, the more it's worth thinking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: because there's a higher upside

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: if you wanna think of it that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And of course in the beginning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: especially in the AlphaGo Zero formulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: everything is shrouded in uncertainty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So you're really swimming in a sea of uncertainty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So it benefits you to, I mean, actually following

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: the same process as you described,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: but because you're so uncertain about everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you basically have to try a lot of different directions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Yeah, so the early parts of the search tree

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: are fairly bushy that it will look

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: at a lot of different possibilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: But fairly quickly, the degree of certainty

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: about some of the moves, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: if a move is really terrible,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you'll pretty quickly find out, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: You'll lose half your pieces or half your territory

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and then you'll say, okay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: this is not worth thinking about anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And then so further down,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: the tree becomes very long and narrow

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and you're following various lines of play,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 moves into the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And that's again, is something that human beings

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: have a very hard time doing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: mainly because they just lack the short-term memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: You just can't remember a sequence of moves

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that's 50 moves long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And you can't imagine the board correctly

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: for that many moves into the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Of course, the top players,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: I'm much more familiar with chess,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: but the top players probably have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: You know, this is what made me work on AI in the first place

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: But then, you know, I thought, okay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And so I started thinking about AI.

body.input: you know, there are things about chess

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: We know the rules of chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: The chess board is completely visible to the program,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: where of course the real world is not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Most of the real world is not visible

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: from wherever you're sitting, so to speak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And to overcome those kinds of problems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you need qualitatively different algorithms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Another thing about the real world is that, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: we regularly, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: involving billions or trillions of steps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: Now, we don't plan those in detail,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: but, you know, when you choose to do a PhD at Berkeley,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that's a five-year commitment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and that amounts to about a trillion motor control steps

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that you will eventually be committed to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: but you're still reasoning on a time scale

body.input: that will eventually reduce

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: to trillions of motor control actions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And so for all of these reasons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you know, AlphaGo and Deep Blue and so on

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: don't represent any kind of threat to humanity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: but they are a step towards it, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And progress in AI occurs by essentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: removing one by one these assumptions

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that make problems easy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: like the assumption of complete observability

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: of the situation, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: We remove that assumption,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: you need a much more complicated kind of computing design,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and you need something that actually keeps track

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: of all the things you can't see

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: and tries to estimate what's going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And there's inevitable uncertainty in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So it becomes a much more complicated problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: But, you know, we are removing those assumptions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: We are starting to have algorithms

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that can cope with much longer time scales,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that can cope with uncertainty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: that can cope with partial observability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: And so each of those steps sort of magnifies by a thousand,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: the range of things that we can do with AI systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: So the way I started in AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: I wanted to be a psychiatrist for a long time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9

body.input: I mean, it was pretty certain that Go,

body.input: in the way we thought about systems that reason,

body.input: was impossible to solve, and now we've solved it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stuart Russell: Long-Term Future of Artificial Intelligence | Lex Fridman Podcast #9
