metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So it seems that it's very speculative

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: on how to protect against that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: But we can definitely and have gotten into trouble

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: on Majedomor systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And a lot of that has to do with the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that the systems that we're building

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: are increasingly complex,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: increasingly poorly understood.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And there's ripple effects that are unpredictable

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: in changing little things

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that can have dramatic consequences on the outcome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And by the way, that's not unique to artificial intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: I think artificial intelligence exacerbates that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: brings it to a new level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: But heck, our electric grid is really complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: The software that runs our financial markets

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is really complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And we've seen those ripple effects

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: translate to dramatic negative consequences,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: like for instance, financial crashes

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that have to do with feedback loops

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that we didn't anticipate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So I think that's an issue that we need to be thoughtful

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: about in many places,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: artificial intelligence being one of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And I think it's really important

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that people are thinking about ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: in which we can have better interpretability of systems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: better tests for, for instance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: measuring the extent to which a machine learning system

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that was trained in one set of circumstances,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: how well does it actually work

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: in a very different set of circumstances

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: where you might say, for instance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: well, I'm not gonna be able to test my automated vehicle

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: in every possible city, village,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and weather condition and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: But if you trained it on this set of conditions

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and then tested it on 50 or 100 others

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that were quite different from the ones

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that you trained it on, then it worked.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: Then that gives you confidence that the next 50

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that you didn't test it on might also work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So effectively it's testing for generalizability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So I think there's ways that we should be

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: constantly thinking about to validate the robustness

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: of our systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: I think it's very different from the,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: let's make sure robots don't take over the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And then the other place where I think we have a threat,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: which is also important for us to think about

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is the extent to which technology can be abused.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So like any really powerful technology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: machine learning can be very much used badly

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: as well as to good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And that goes back to many other technologies

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that I've come up with when people invented

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: projectile missiles and it turned into guns,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and people invented nuclear power

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and it turned into nuclear bombs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And I think honestly I would say that to me gene editing

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and CRISPR is at least as dangerous a technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: if used badly than as machine learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: You could create really nasty viruses and such

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: using gene editing that are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: you know, you would be really careful about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So anyway, that's something that we need

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: to be really thoughtful about whenever we have any

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: really powerful new technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: Yeah, and in the case of machine learning is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: adversarial machine learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: so all the kinds of attacks like security almost threats

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and there's a social engineering

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: with machine learning algorithms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And there's face recognition and big brothers watching you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And there is the killer drones that can potentially go

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and targeted execution of people in a different country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: I don't, you know, one can argue that bombs

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: are not necessarily that much better,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: but you know, if people wanna kill someone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: they'll find a way to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So if you, in general, if you look at trends in the data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: there's less wars, there's less violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: there's more human rights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So we've been doing overall quite good as a human species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: Are you optimistic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: Surprisingly sometimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: Are you optimistic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: Maybe another way to ask is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: do you think most people are good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And fundamentally, we tend towards a better world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: which is underlying the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: will machine learning with gene editing

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: ultimately land us somewhere good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: Are you optimistic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: I think by and large, I'm optimistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: I think that most people mean well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: That doesn't mean that most people are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: you know, altruistic do-gooders,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: but I think most people mean well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: But I think it's also really important for us as a society

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: to create social norms where doing good

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and being perceived well by our peers

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is, are positively correlated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: I mean, it's very easy to create dysfunctional societies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: There's certainly multiple psychological experiments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: as well as sadly real world events

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: where people have devolved to a world

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: where being perceived well by your peers

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is correlated with really atrocious,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: often genocidal behaviors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So we really want to make sure

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that we maintain a set of social norms

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: where people know that to be a successful number of society,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: you want to be doing good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And one of the things that I sometimes worry about

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is that some societies don't seem to necessarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: be moving in the forward direction in that regard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: where it's not necessarily the case that doing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that being a good person is what makes you be perceived well

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: by your peers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And I think that's a really important thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: for us as a society to remember.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: It's very easy to degenerate back into a universe

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: where it's okay to do really bad stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and still have your peers think you're amazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: It's fun to ask a world-class computer scientist

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and engineer a ridiculously philosophical question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: like what is the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: Let me ask, what gives your life meaning?

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: What is the source of fulfillment, happiness, joy, purpose?

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: When we were starting Coursera in the fall of 2011,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that was right around the time that Steve Jobs passed away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And so the media was full of various famous quotes

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that he uttered and one of them that really stuck with me

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: because it resonated with stuff that I'd been feeling

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: for even years before that is that our goal in life

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is to be able to do something that's meaningful

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is that our goal in life should be to make a dent

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So I think that to me, what gives my life meaning

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is that I would hope that when I am lying there

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: on my deathbed and looking at what I'd done in my life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that I can point to ways in which I have left the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: a better place than it was when I entered it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: This is something I tell my kids all the time

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: because I also think that the burden of that

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: is much greater for those of us who were born to privilege.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And in some ways I was, I mean, I wasn't born super wealthy

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: or anything like that, but I grew up in an educated family

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: with parents who loved me and took care of me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And I had a chance at a great education

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: and I always had enough to eat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: So I was in many ways born to privilege

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: more than the vast majority of humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And my kids I think are even more so born to privilege

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: than I was fortunate enough to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: And I think it's really important that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: especially for those of us who have that opportunity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: that we use our lives to make the world a better place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning | Lex Fridman Podcast #93

body.input: I don't think there's a better way to end it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: has ever hit a deadline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And then on GM?

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: That's probably true, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And GM side is probably the opposite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: So that culture gap is really fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: So you're optimistic about the future of that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Yeah, I mean, from what I've seen, it's impressive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And I think, especially in Silicon Valley,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: it's easy to write off building cars because people

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: have been doing that for over 100 years now in this country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And so it seems like that's a solved problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: but that doesn't mean it's an easy problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And I think it would be easy to sort of overlook that

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: and think that we're Silicon Valley engineers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: we can solve any problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Building a car, it's been done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Therefore, it's not a real engineering challenge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: But after having seen just the sheer scale and magnitude

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: and industrialization that occurs inside

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: of an automotive assembly plant, that

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: is a lot of work that I am very glad that we don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: have to reinvent to make self-driving cars work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And so to have partners who have done that for 100 years

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: and have these great processes and this huge infrastructure

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: and supply base that we can tap into is just remarkable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Because the scope and surface area

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: of the problem of deploying fleets of self-driving cars

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: is so large that we're constantly

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: looking for ways to do less so we can focus on the things that

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: really matter more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And if we had to figure out how to build a symbol and build

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: the cars themselves, I mean, we work closely with GM on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: But if we had to develop all that capability in-house

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: as well, that would just make the problem really

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: intractable, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: So yeah, just like your first entry at the MIT DARPA

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: challenge when there was the motor that failed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: if somebody that knows what they're doing with the motor

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: did it, they could just focus on the software.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Not the hardware platform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: So from your perspective now, there

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: are so many ways that autonomous vehicles can impact society

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: in the next year, five years, 10 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: What do you think is the biggest opportunity

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: to make money in autonomous driving,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: sort of make it a financially viable thing in the near term?

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: What do you think would be the biggest impact there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Well, the things that drive the economics for fleets

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: of self-driving cars, there's sort

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: of a handful of variables.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: One is the cost to build the vehicle itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: So the material cost, what's the cost of all your sensors

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: plus the cost of the vehicle and all the other components on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Another one is the lifetime of the vehicle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: It's very different if your vehicle drives 100,000 miles

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: and then it falls apart versus 2 million.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And then if you have a fleet, it's kind of like an airplane

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: or an airline where once you produce the vehicle,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: you want it to be in operation as many hours a day

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: as possible producing revenue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And then the other piece of that is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: how are you generating revenue?

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: I think that's kind of what you're asking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And I think the obvious things today

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: are the ride sharing business because that's pretty clear

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: that there's demand for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: There's existing markets you can tap into.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Large urban areas, that kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And I think that there are some real benefits

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: to having cars without drivers compared

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: to sort of the status quo for people who use ride share

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: services today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: You get privacy, consistency, hopefully significantly

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: improve safety, all these benefits

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: versus the current product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: But it's a crowded market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And then other opportunities, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: you've seen a lot of activity in the last six or 12 months,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: is delivery, whether that's parcels and packages, food,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: or groceries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Those are all sort of, I think, opportunities

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: that are pretty ripe for these.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Once you have this core technology, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: is the fleet of autonomous vehicles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: there's all sorts of different business opportunities

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: you can build on top of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: But I think the important thing, of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: is that there's zero monetization opportunity

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: until you actually have that fleet of very capable driverless

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: cars that are as good or better than humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: And that's sort of where the entire industry is

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: sort of in this holding pattern right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: Yeah, they're trying to achieve that baseline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: But you said sort of not reliability, consistency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: It's kind of interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: I think I heard you say somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: I'm not sure if that's what you meant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: But I can imagine a situation where

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: you would get an autonomous vehicle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: I wouldn't say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: No, I'd say within reasonable bounds, as in we're not going

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

body.input: to, I think it'd be highly unlikely we'd expose any knob

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Kyle Vogt: Cruise Automation | Lex Fridman Podcast #14

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And there's a lot of beautiful properties for proof of work

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: well, what does proof of work actually do for you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And it turns out it does a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: they can run a calculation

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and they will always pick the longest chain,

body.input: from the destruction of a system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So that's something that proof of stake doesn't suffer from

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And everyone come in and ask me some question

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And I take the time to sit down and answer the question

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: who could answer that particular type of question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And there were some amazing people in the early days

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: He said, oh wow, Bitcoin can come to a cell phone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: This is really cool and exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And then what happened, Mike left Bitcoin in 2013

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: like he was subhuman or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So I don't know, the culture has changed a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And if they like it, it's good for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: They can enjoy the religion, but it's not for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And where I like being is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: like I had a guy who used to work for me, Alex Cherponoy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and he created this beautiful project called Ergo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: To me, that is the spiritual successor to Bitcoin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Ergo is really special

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: because it has the same culture, it has the same mentality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and the technology is kind of like a natural evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: of what you would do if you knew about Bitcoin

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and you wanted to build the next big thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but he added UTXO with some smart contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And there's all these other beautiful little things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And he's this brilliant Russian programmer

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and he surrounded himself

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: with all these other brilliant people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: He has zero ego.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: He has negative ego.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: your ego goes down, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And everything about Alex is always like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: How do I do that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And he gets legitimately excited when he meets somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that he can collaborate with or learn from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: That's where Bitcoin was in the beginning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Everybody set their egos aside,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: whether it was Hal Finney or whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and they would just say, how can I help?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: What can I do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And it was all about coming up with some cool new thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: or solving some cool new problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So quite a few people are excited about Ergo

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and excited about the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that you kind of appreciate Alex and Ergo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: as part of this pool for the consensus mechanism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: I mean, anything's possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And there's a lot of evolution Ergo has to go through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And Ergo was, it was kind of like,

body.input: while they were prototyping it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Microsoft needed a development environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: They ironically purchased a lot of Apple computers

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So Apple's moving away from the PowerPC to Intel

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and Microsoft was moving towards the PowerPC.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: It's just this weird intersection of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So at that time, the largest order of Mac computers made

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: was done by Microsoft.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And they're using it for Xbox stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So Ergo, we viewed the same way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So we said, well, we have this extended UTXO model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: The only thing that's sufficiently close to it

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where we can beta test contracts is actually with Ergo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And Alex just was a little faster

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: in getting certain things out

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: because we were doing things in a slightly more rigorous way

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and slightly more expressive way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So we actually tested a stable coin and Oracle

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and other things on Ergo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And it has just incredible community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: When we said, hey, we're coming here to work and build,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: oh yeah, we love work with you guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: This is so cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: The other thing is Alex used to work for us

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and he had this lovely project called Scorax.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And it was all about like a pedagogical framework

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: for building blockchains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And if you wanna do prototyping or academic research,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: it was great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: It was super modular and it separated the consensus network

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and transaction layer from each other

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: in just the right way so that you can make it modular

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and mix and max things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So you can put secure academia in

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: or maybe a different network layer

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and a different consensus protocol,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: like proof of work to another proof of work and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So we loved having that kind of IP sitting around

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: because it gave us the ability to kind of play around

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: with ideas in a matter of weeks instead of months or years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And then he just took that concept and he gave it away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: The WAVE protocol was built on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: That was Sasha Ivanov, he did that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And I think there's two or three other cryptocurrencies

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that were launched from Scorax.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And then Alex took that and built Ergo from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So there was a nice intersection

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where there was overlapping technology with Ergo,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: with our technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And the other thing was that the community

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: was so open and friendly, it was just a no-brainer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Just go in and start building some things there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Now, in terms of evolving ideas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: the whole Sigma protocol idea is very different

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and it's very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And there's a guy at a Boston University,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: his name will come to me in a segment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: who came up with this stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And I think there's some merit there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: especially as we start moving closer to this idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: of blockchains being used to validate proofs

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: instead of running computation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: What's the Sigma protocol, by the way?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So it's just a way of expressing scripts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And basically you get these concise representations

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: of proofs and then you can say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: okay, the script is correct,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but you don't have to run the whole program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So there's a lot, I'm not doing the topic justice,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: there's a lot more to it, but that's the basic concept.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And in a Redeemer validator model,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you need stuff like that because as your model

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: gets more complex and a lot more things happen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you don't want to have a situation where I have to run,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: replay a huge amount of the UTXO graph

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to be able to get to a point

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where I have the state of the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: You need some mathematical artifact

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that gives you the state of the system quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And then you're saying, okay, I now know

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: what computation thread I need to run

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to be able to get enough to be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to redeem this transaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So he just found a more compressed representation of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And the math doesn't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: What matters is there's a whole beautiful field

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that thinks about this type of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And it was never once linked before into our industry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: The brilliance of Alex was to actually realize

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you could do that and pull those things together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And it may actually have some merit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but by no means is the only guy that does this stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: There was actually other approaches

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: in verified computing that have explored that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Like my favorite came out of Microsoft research

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: is a project called Pinocchio.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And there was a followup called Geppetto.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And the basic idea was that it's fortuitous

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that you have these computer science problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: like hashing where you can do all this computation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And once you've done all of it

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and you found this magic number

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that you can verify that the computation was done correctly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So the proof of work works this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Hard to do the proof of work,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: easy to check the proof of work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Cryptography also works this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: You have some trap door

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where you can verify something's correct,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but to get that thing done,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: if you're doing it brute force,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: it takes an enormous amount of computation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Well, not all problems are like this, like protein folding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: To verify the protein is folded correctly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you have to fold the protein.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So you have to redo the work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: But what if for arbitrary computation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you could take a problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and then you could generate a proof

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that you've done that computation correctly

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and the proof validates in logarithmic time or constant time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Wow, that's incredible, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Well, Microsoft actually wrote a paper on how to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: It's called Pinocchio.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So that's another example of these types of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: these roll-ups of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where instead of doing the computation on chain

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: or trying to create some sort of replicated machine

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that does all this stuff,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you instead just say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: okay, only thing I'm gonna use the blockchain for

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: is to check your proof,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but I'm gonna turn it into a distributed computing problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and any person in the world can do the problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: on any server, untrusted server even,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: because you don't have to trust the output,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you trust the proof and the proof is deterministic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: It tells you these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So whether you're using zero knowledge or sigma protocols

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: or some other mechanism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: it's moving you in that particular direction

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to turn it from a replicated to a distributed problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and go from I'm doing the work to I'm checking

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that the work was done correctly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: That's fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And all of a sudden we're back to the P equals MP thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where for many very interesting problems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: the checking is efficient,
