body.input: is much more efficient than the solving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Right, and also do you want complete determinism

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: or is it probabilistic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Because if you relax that requirement a little bit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: then suddenly actually you have a broader class of things

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you can construct this stuff for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: You mentioned UTXO,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: there's a paper titled the Extended UTXO Model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: It writes in the introduction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Bitcoin and Ethereum hosting the two currently most valuable

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and popular cryptocurrencies

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: use two rather different ledger models

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: known as the UTXO Model and the account model respectively.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: At the same time, these two public blockchains

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: differ strongly in the expressiveness

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: of the smart contracts that they support.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: This is no coincidence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Ethereum chose the account model explicitly to facilitate

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: more expressive smart contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: On the other hand, Bitcoin chose UTXO also for good reasons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: including that it's semantic model stays simple

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: in a complex concurrent

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and distributed computing environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: This raises the question of whether it is possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to have expressive smart contracts

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: while keeping the semantic simplicity of the UTXO Model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So what's the fuck that means?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: What is UTXO?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: What is the account model?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And what is the idea of the Extended UTXO Model?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So I guess the easiest way of visualizing it is

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that UTXO is kind of like cash register accounting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So, let's assume you don't have credit cards,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you just have cash.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And so when you go and buy some milk and potatoes

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: or whatever, you go to the cashier,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you pull out your $20 bill, you give it to them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: unless it comes up to 17.50, they have to make change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So you don't tear your $20 bill,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: cut a piece of it off and say, here's part of my 20.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: You give them the entire $20 bill,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and then they give you something back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And the things that they give you back

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: are also atomic units.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: They don't cut those things up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So that's kind of what UTXO is all about in a nutshell,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: is that there's inputs and outputs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: your inputs that 20 and your outputs will be the 17.50

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that goes to them, and then the remaining change

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that goes back to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: The problem with this particular model

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: is that the way it was implemented with Bitcoin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: there was no notion of how do we run complex predicates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: complex contracts on this thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where instead of just saying, okay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: I'm just gonna push value to you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: I wanna put lots of terms and conditions

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: into the movement of that value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Like you only get this if I mow your lawn on Tuesday,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: or you only get this if some event happens,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: like the Broncos win the Super Bowl or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Okay, so you need some notion of programmability with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So a lot of people are trying to figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: in the early days of Bitcoin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: how could we improve the expressiveness of the system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And one of ways of doing it is you can go

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to a different accounting model, bank-style accounting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So in a bank ledger, every time you do a withdrawal deposit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: it's a mutable system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: With the cash register accounting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you don't tear up the bills with the bank,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you can deduct or add to the ledger all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So Ethereum kind of works in that bank accounting system

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where you send messages, you send transactions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and you're going up or down,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and so you can trigger programs the same way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So what we did is we said, okay,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: if you take the UTXO model and you add some data to it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and instead of saying it's just a digital signature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but it's in a script,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you can basically create something

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that's still the same as cash register,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but now you have programmability

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and the big difference is local versus global.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So in the case of UTXO, your scripts are your concerns.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So whatever's going on in that cash register

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: has no bearing or impact on the other cash registers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: But when you look at bank accounting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you have to know the state of the entire banking world

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to be able to make that work, why?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Because if that transaction's inbound,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that wire transfer is inbound,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you have to know those funds are actually there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that thing is actually happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So when you have a global state for a program,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: it's like you could do a lot more with it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but it's a lot more dangerous,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and so you have to build all these mechanisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to try to protect yourself from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So what we did is we said, okay, add data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: add a programmability,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and you're kind of in this nice Goldilocks zone

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: between what Ethereum did with an account-style model

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and a global state system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and you're not as restrictive as Bitcoin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but you're still in an entering complete world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: you can still run all kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And then any standard mathematician,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: they'll say, okay, well, is it isomorphic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: Is there a mapping between this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: What type of function can I actually take something expressed

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: in one structure and transmit it to the other structure

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and properties are preserved?

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So we wrote a paper, it's called Climatic Ledgers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: where we actually showed that UTXO,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: extended UTXO and accounts are somewhat similar,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and that you could map things that happen in one system

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to the other system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: the properties are preserved between the two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So in practice, what's nice about extended UTXO

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: is that you can put infrastructure on top of it

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to make the development experience relatively similar

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to the development experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: of what you would do with Ethereum,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: but you don't have to worry about this global state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So when you talk about sharding,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: it's a lot easier to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: It's a lot more conceivable to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And also you get determinism in the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So when I have a Plutus smart contract,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: whatever I run locally is exactly

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: what I expect to run in the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: When you have a concept

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: of this mutable global state in the system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: whatever you run locally is not necessarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: what you're gonna get

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: when you actually push it into the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So you may misprice things and the contract will fail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: It doesn't ever happen in the Plutus world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So you get a lot of advantages with this particular model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: The downside is that it's a little bit less expressive

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: on the boundaries and a little bit harder

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: to write certain types of software with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: But again, how you resolve that

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: is you kind of build higher level languages

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and other such things that compensate

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: for these types of things and design patterns

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that compensate for these types of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: The other advantage that we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that's really fun and exciting

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: is that Bitcoin lives in this model

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: and there are other UTXO based systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And so they're all talking about smart contracts as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And they would like to continue working in the UTXO model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So if you're a Bitcoin contract developer or other things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: there's actually already a group of people

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that understand this very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And that's still a fairly large part

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: of the mind share of the entire space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: So there are no silver bullets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And anytime you pick a particular model,

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: there's an upside and a downside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: And there's different ways of doing things

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: from cash register accounting or bank accounting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: You can even do different accounting models.

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: But we felt this was kind of the best first step to go into

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: because we started with something very familiar

metadata.title: Podcast: Charles Hoskinson: Cardano | Lex Fridman Podcast #192

body.input: that had a long history behind it.

body.input: This concept of immutability and these things

body.input: and much more strict management of state

body.input: and no notion of having this global concept

body.input: that you have to kind of manage as you break up the system.
