metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What's the challenge there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So there are a couple of ways that I could slice this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: but the one that I think is simplest for people to understand involves money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you look at how we got to the Moon in the 1960s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There's about 10-year duration between the challenge that President Kennedy laid out

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and our successfully landing a moon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I was actually here at MIT when that first moon landing occurred,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: so I remember watching it on TV.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But how did we get there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, we had this extraordinary technical agency of the United States government, NASA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It consumed about 5% of the country's economic output.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so you say 5% of the economic output over about a 10-year period gets us 250,000 miles in space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Mars is about 100 times farther.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you have at least 100 times the challenge,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and we're spending about one-tenth of the funds that we spent then as a government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So my claim is that it's at least 1,000 times harder for me to imagine us getting to Mars by 2030.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And you had that part that you mentioned in the speech that I just have to throw in there of JFK,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: of we do these things not because they're easy, but because they're hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's such a beautiful line that I would love to hear a modern president say about a scientific endeavor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, one day we live in hope that such a president will arise for our nation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But even if, like I said, even if you fix the technical problems,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: it's the biological engineering that I worry most about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: However, I'm going to go out on a limb here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I think that by 2090 or so, or 2100, should I say 120, I suspect we're going to have a human on Mars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Wow. So you think that many years out, first a few tangents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You said bioengineering is a challenge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, what's the challenge there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So as I said, the real problem with interstellar travel, aside from the technology challenges,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: the real problem is radiation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And how do you engineer either an environment or a body,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: because we see rapid advances going on in bioengineering,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: how do you engineer either a ship or body so that something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: some person that's recognizably human will survive the rigors of interplanetary space travel?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's much more difficult than most people seem to take into account.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So if we could linger on the 2090, 2100, 2120, sort of thinking of that kind of, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and let's linger on money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos are pushing the cost, trying to push the cost down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I mean, this is, so do you have hope, as this actually, sort of a brilliant big picture scientist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: do you think a business entrepreneur can take science and make it cheaper and get it out there faster?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So bending the cost curve, you'll notice that has been an anchor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: This is the simplest way for me to discuss this with people about what the challenge is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So yes, bending the cost curve is certainly critical if we're going to be successful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Now, you ask about the endeavors that are out there now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: sponsored by two very prominent American citizens, Jeff Bezos and Elon Musk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I'm disappointed actually in what I see in terms of the routes that are being pursued.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So let me give you one example there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: This one is going to be a little bit more technical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So if you look at the kinds of rockets that both these organizations are creating,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: yes, it's wonderful reusable technology to see a rocket go up and land on its fins,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: just like it did in science fiction movies when I was a kid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's astounding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But the real problem is those rockets, the technology that we're doing now is not really that different

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: than what was used to go to the moon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And there are alternatives, it turns out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There's an engine called a flare engine, which,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: so a traditional rocket, if you look at the engine, looks like a bell, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And then the flame comes out the bottom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But there is a kind of engine called a flare engine, which is essentially,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: when you look at it, it looks like an exhaust pipe on like a fancy car that's long and elongated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And it's a type of rocket engine that we know, we know it's there been preliminary testing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: we know it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And it also is actually much more economical because what it does is allow you

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: to vary the amount of thrust as you go up in a way that you cannot do

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: with one of these bell-shaped engines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you would think that an entrepreneur might try to have the breakthrough to use flare nozzles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: as they're called, as a way to bend the cost curve,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: because as we keep coming back, that's going to be a big factor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But that's not happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: In fact, what we see is what I think of as incremental change in terms of our technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So I'm not really very encouraged by what I personally see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So incremental change won't bend the cost curve anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I don't see it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Just to linger on the sci-fi for one more question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Do you think we're alone in the universe?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Are we the only intelligent form of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So there is a quote by Carl Sagan, which I really love when I hear this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And I recall the quote, and it goes something like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: if we're the only conscious life in the universe, it's a terrible waste of space,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: because the universe is an incredibly big place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And when Carl made that statement, we didn't know about the profusion of planets that are out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: In the last decade, we've discovered over a thousand planets,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and a substantial number of those planets are Earth-like in terms of being

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: in the Goldilocks zone, as it's called.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So it's, in my mind, it's practically inconceivable

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that we're the only conscious form of life in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But that doesn't mean they've come to visit us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Do you think they would look, do you think we'll recognize alien life if we saw it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Do you think it'd look anything like the carbon base, the biological system we have on Earth today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It would depend on that life's native environment in which it arose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: If that environment was sufficiently like our environment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: there's a principle in biology and nature called convergence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: which is that even if you have two biological systems that are totally separated from each other,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: if they face similar conditions, nature tends to converge on solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so there might be similarities if this alien life form was born

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: in a place that's kind of like this place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Physics appears to be quite similar, the laws of physics across the entirety of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Do you think weirder things than we see on Earth can spring up out of the same kinds of laws of physics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: From the laws of physics, I would say yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: First of all, if you look at carbon-based life, why are we carbon-based?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, it turns out it's because of the way that carbon interacts with elements,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: which in fact is also a reflection on the electronic structure of the carbon nucleus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you can look down the table of elements and say, well, gee, do we see similar elements?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The answer is yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And one that one often hears about in science fiction is silicon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So maybe there's a silicon-based life form out there if the conditions are right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I think it's presumptuous of us to think that we are the template by which all life has to appear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Before we dive into beautiful details, let me ask a big question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What to you is the most beautiful idea, maybe the most surprising mysterious idea in physics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The most surprising idea to me is that we can actually do physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The universe did not have to be constructed in such a way that our,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: with our limited intellectual capacity, that is actually put together in such a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and that we are put together in such a way that we can, with our mind's eye,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: delve incredibly deeply into the structure of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That to me is pretty close to a miracle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So there are simple equations, relatively simple, that can describe things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: you know, the fundamental functions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: They can describe everything about our reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's not, can you imagine universes where everything is a lot more complicated?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Do you think there's something inherent about universes that simple laws are?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, first of all, let me, this is a question that I encounter in a number of guides is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: a lot of people will raise the question about whether mathematics is the language of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And my response is, mathematics is the language that we humans are capable of using

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: in describing the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It may have little to do with the universe, but in terms of our capacity, it's the microscope,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: it's the telescope through which we, it's the lens through which we are able to view the universe

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: with the precision that no other human language allows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So could there be other universes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, I don't even know if this one looks like I think it does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But the beautiful, surprising thing is that physics, there are laws of physics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: very few laws of physics that can effectively compress down the functioning of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Yes, that's extraordinarily surprising.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I like to use the analogy with computers and information technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: If you worry about transmitting large bundles of data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: one of the things that computer scientists do for us is they allow for processes

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that are called compression, where you take big packets of data and you press them down

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: into much smaller packets and then you transmit those and then unpack them at the other end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so it looks a little bit to me like the universe has kind of done us a favor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's constructed our minds in such a way that we have this thing called mathematics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: which then as we look at the universe, teaches us how to carry out the compression process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: A quick question about compression, do you think the human mind can be compressed?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The biology can be compressed?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: We talked about space travel, to be able to compress the information that captures some large percent

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: of what it means to be me or you and then be able to send that at the speed of light?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Wow, that's a big question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And let me try to take it apart, unpack it into several pieces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I don't believe that wetware biology such as we are has an exclusive patent on intellectual consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I suspect that other structures in the universe are perfectly capable of producing the data streams

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that we use to process, first of all, our observations of the universe and an awareness of ourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I can imagine other structures can do that also.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So that's part of what you were talking about, which I would have some disagreement with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What's the most interesting part of consciousness of us humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Is consciousness is the thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I think that's the most interesting thing about humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And then you're saying that there's other entities throughout the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I can imagine, I can well imagine that the architecture that supports our consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: again, has no patent on consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Just in case you have an interesting thought here, there's folks perhaps in philosophy

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: called panpsychists that believe consciousness underlies everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It is one of the fundamental laws of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Do you have a sense that that could possibly fit into?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I don't know the answer to that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: One part of that belief system is Gia, which is that there's a kind of conscious life force

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: about our planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And I've encountered these things before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I don't quite know what to make of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: My own life experience, and I'll be 69 in about two months, and I have spent all my

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: adulthood thinking about the way that mathematics interacts with nature and with us to try to

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: understand nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And all I can tell you from all of my integrated experience is that there is something extraordinarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: mysterious to me about our universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: This is something that Einstein said from his life experience as a scientist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And this mysteriousness almost feels like the universe is our parent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's a very strange thing perhaps to hear scientists say, but there are just so many

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: strange coincidences that you just get a sense that something is going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, I interrupted you in terms of compressing what we're down to a consensus at the speed

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: of light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So, the first thing is I would argue that it's probably very likely that artificial

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: intelligence ultimately will develop something like consciousness, something that for us

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: will probably be indistinguishable from consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So that's what I meant by our biological processing equipment that we carry up here probably does

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: not hold a patent on consciousness because it's really about the data streams.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I mean, as far as I can tell, that's what we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: We are self-actuating, self-learning data streams.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That to me is the most accurate way I can tell you what I have seen in my lifetime about

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: what humans are at the level of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So if that's the case, then you just need to have an architecture that supports that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: information processing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So let's assume that that's true, that in fact what we call consciousness is really

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: about a very peculiar kind of data stream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: If that's the case, then if you can export that to a piece of hardware, something metal,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: electronic, what have you, then you certainly will ultimately that kind of consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: could get to Mars very quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It doesn't have our problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You can engineer the body, as I said, it's a ship or a body, you engineer one or both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Send it at a speed of light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, that one is a more difficult one because that now goes beyond just a matter of having

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: a data stream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's now the preservation of the information in the data stream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so unless you can build something that's like a super, super, super version of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: way the internet works, because most people aren't aware that the internet itself is actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: a miracle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's based on a technology called message packaging.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So if you could exponentiate message packaging in some way to preserve the information that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: in the data stream, then maybe your dream becomes true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You mentioned with artificial intelligence, sort of us human beings not having a monopoly

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: on consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Is the idea of artificial intelligence systems, computational systems being able to basically

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: replacing us humans, scare you, excite you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What do you think about that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So I'm going to tell you about a conversation I once had with Eric Schmidt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I was sitting at a meeting with him and he was a few feet away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And he turned to me and he said something like, you know, Jim, in maybe a decade or

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: so we're going to have computers that do what you do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And my response was not unless they can dream, because there's something about the way that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: we humans actually generate creativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's somehow I get this sense of my lived experience and watching creative people that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: is somehow connected to the irrational parts of what goes on in our head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And dreaming is part of that irrational.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So unless you can build a piece of artificial intelligence that dreams, I have a strong

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: suspicion that you will not get something that will fully be conscious by a definition

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that I would accept, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you mentioned dreaming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You've played around with some out there fascinating ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: How do you think and we'll start diving into the world of the very small ideas of super

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: symmetry and all that in terms of visualization, in terms of how do you think about it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: How do you dream of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: How do you come up with ideas in that fascinating mysterious space?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So in my workspace, which is basically where I am charged with coming up on a mathematical

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: palette with new ideas that will help me understand the structure of nature and hopefully help

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: all of us understand the structure of nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I've observed several different ways in which my creativity expresses itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There's one mode which looks pretty normal, which I sort of think of as the Chinese water

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: torture method, just drop, drop, drop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You get more and more information and suddenly it all congeals and you get a clear picture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so that's kind of a standard way of working.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And I think that's how most people think about the way technical people solve problems, that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: it's kind of you accumulate this body of information and at a certain point you synthesize it and

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: then boom, there's something new.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But I've also observed in myself and other scientists that there are other ways that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: we are creative and these other ways to me are actually far more powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I first personally experienced this when I was a freshman at MIT, live over in Baker

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: House right across the campus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And I was in a calculus course, 1801 is called at MIT and calculus comes in two different

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: flavors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: One of them is called differential calculus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The other is called integral calculus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Integral calculus is the calculus that Newton invented to describe motion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It turns out integral calculus was probably invented about 1700 years earlier by Archimedes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: but we didn't know that when I was a freshman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But so that's what you study as a student and the differential calculus part of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: course was to me, I wouldn't, how do I say this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It was something that by the drip, drip, drip method you could sort of figure it out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Now the integral part of calculus, I could memorize the formula.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That was not the formula.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That was not the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The problem was why in my own mind, why do these formulae work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And because of that, when I was in the part of the calculus course where we had to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: multiple substitutions to solve integrals, I had a lot of difficulty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I was emotionally involved in my education because this is where I think the passion

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and emotion comes to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And it caused an emotional crisis that I was having these difficulties understanding the

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: integral part of calculus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The why of it, not the rote memorization of fact, but the why of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Why does this work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so one night I was over in my dormitory room in Baker House.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I was trying to do a calculus problem set.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I was getting nowhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I got a terrific headache.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I went to sleep and had this very strange dream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And when I awoke awakened, I could do three and four substitutions and integrals with

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: relative ease.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Now this to me was an astounding experience because I had never before in my life understood

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that one's subconscious is actually capable of being harnessed to do mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I experienced this and I've experienced this more than once.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So this was just the first time why I remember it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So that's why when it comes to like really wickedly tough problems, I think that the

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: kind of creativity that you need to solve them is probably this second variety which

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: comes somehow from dreaming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Do you think, again, I told you I'm Russian so we romanticize suffering, but do you think

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: part of that equation is the suffering leading up to that dreaming?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So the suffering is I am convinced that this kind of creative, this second mode of creativity

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: as I like to call it, I'm convinced that this second mode of creativity is in fact that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: suffering is a kind of crucible that triggers it because the mind I think is struggling

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: to get out of this and the only way that you can actually solve the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And even though you're not consciously solving problems, something is going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And I've talked about to a few other people and I've heard other similar stories.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so the way I guess what I think about it is it's a little bit like the way that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: thermonuclear weapons work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I don't know if you know how they work, but a thermonuclear weapon is actually two bombs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's an atomic bomb which sort of does a compression and then you have a fusion bomb that goes

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: off and somehow that emotional pressure I think acts like the first stage of a thermonuclear

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: weapon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's when we get really big thoughts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The analogy between thermonuclear weapons and the subconscious, the connection there

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: is at least visually is kind of interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There may be, Freud would have a few things to say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, part of it is probably based on my own trajectory through life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: My father was in the US Army for 27 years and so I started my life out on military basis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so a lot of probably the things that wander around in my subconscious are connected to

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I apologize for all the tangents, but-

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, you're doing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But you're encouraging by answering the stupid questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: No, they're not stupid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Your father was in the Army.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What do you think about Neil deGrasse Tyson?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: He wrote a book on interlinking the progress of science to sort of the aspirations of our

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60
