body.input: Beautifully put.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Let's dive into the world of the very small if we could for a bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What are the basic particles either experimentally observed or hypothesized by physicists?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So as we physicists look at the universe, you can, first of all, there are two big buckets

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: of particles that is the smallest objects that we are able to currently mathematically

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: conceive and then experimentally verify that these ideas have a sense of accuracy to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So one of those buckets we call matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: These are things like electrons, things that are like quarks, which are particles that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: exist inside of protons, and there's a whole family of these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There are in fact 18 quarks and apparently six electron-like objects that we call leptons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So that's one bucket.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The other bucket that we see both in our mathematics as well as in our experimental equipment are

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: a set of particles that you can call force carriers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The most familiar force carrier is the photon, the particle of light that allows you to see

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: In fact, it's the same object that carries electric repulsion between like charges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: From science fiction, we have the object called the graviton, which is talked about a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: in science fiction and Star Trek.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But the graviton is also a mathematical object that we physicists have known about essentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: since Einstein wrote his theory of general relativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There are four forces in nature, the fundamental forces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There is the gravitational force, its carrier is the graviton.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There are three other forces in nature, the electromagnetic force, the strong nuclear

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: force, and the weak nuclear force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And each one of these forces has one or more carriers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The photon is the carrier of the electromagnetic force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The strong nuclear force actually has eight carriers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: They're called gluons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And then the weak nuclear force has three carriers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: They're called the W+, W-, and Z bosons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So those are the things that both in mathematics and in experiments, by the way, the most precise

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: experiments were ever as a species able to conduct is about measuring the accuracy of

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: these ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And we know that at least to one part in a billion, these ideas are right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So first of all, you've made it sound both elegant and simple, but is it crazy to you

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that there is force carriers?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Like, is that supposed to be a trivial idea to think about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: If we think about photons, gluons, that there's four fundamental forces of physics, and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: those forces are expressed, there's carriers of those forces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Is that a kind of trivial thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's not a trivial thing at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: In fact, it was a puzzle for Sir Isaac Newton because he's the first person to give us basically

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Before Isaac Newton, physics didn't exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What did exist was called natural philosophy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So discussions about using the methods of classical philosophy to understand nature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: natural philosophy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So the Greeks, we call them scientists, but they were natural philosophers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Physics doesn't get born until Newton writes the Principia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: One of the things that puzzled him was how gravity works because if you read very carefully

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: what he writes, he basically says, and I'm paraphrasing badly, but he basically says

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that someone who thinks deeply about this subject would find it inconceivable that an

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: object in one place or location can magically reach out and affect another object with nothing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: intervening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so it puzzled him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Does it puzzle you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Action at a distance?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I mean, not as a physicist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It would, it would, except that I am a physicist, and we have long ago resolved this issue,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and the resolution came about through a second great physicist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Most people have heard of Newton.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Most people have heard of Einstein, but between the two of them, there was another extraordinarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: great physicist, a man named James Clark Maxwell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And Maxwell, between these two other giants, taught us about electric and magnetic forces,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and it's from his equations that one can figure out that there's a carrier called the photon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So this was resolved for physicists around 1860 or so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So what are bosons and fermions and hadrons, elementary and composites?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So earlier I said- Two buckets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You have got two buckets if you want to try to build the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You got to start off with things on these two buckets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you got to have things, that's the matter, and then you have to have other objects that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: act on them to cause those things to cohere to fixed finite patterns because you need

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: those fixed finite patterns as building blocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So that's the way our universe looks to people like me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Now the building blocks do different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So let's go back to these two buckets again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Let me start with a bucket containing the particle of light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Let me imagine I'm in a dusty room with two flashlights and I have one flashlight, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I direct directly in front of me, and then I have you stand over to say my left, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: then we both take our flashlights and turn them on and make sure the beams go right through

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And the beams do just that, they go right through each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: They don't bounce off of each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The reason the room has to be dusty is because we want to see the light.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The room dust wasn't there, we wouldn't actually see the light until it got to the other wall,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Because it's the dust in the air.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But the dupe beams actually pass right through each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: They literally pass right through.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: They don't affect each other at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: One acts like the other one's not there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The particle of light is the simplest example that shows that behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's a boson.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Now let's imagine that we're in the same dusty room and this time you have a bucket of balls

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and I have a bucket of balls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: We try to throw them so that we get something like a beam, throwing them fast, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: If they collide, they don't just pass through each other, they bounce off of each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Now that's mostly because they have electric charge and electric charges, light charges

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: repel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But mathematically I know how to turn off the electric charge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: If you do that, you'll find they still repel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And it's because they are these things we call fermions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So this is how you distinguish the things that are in the two buckets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: They are either bosons or fermions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Which of them, and maybe you can mention the most popular of the bosons?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The most recently discovered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's like when I was in high school and there was a really popular majorette.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Right.

body.input: So the two buckets that I've actually described to you have all been first hypothesized and

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: then verified by observation, with the Higgs boson being the most recent one of these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: We haven't actually verified the graviton, interestingly enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Mathematically, we have an expectation that graviton is like this, but we've not performed

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: an experiment to show that this is an accurate idea that nature uses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So something has to be a carrier of force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: For the force of gravity, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It can be something way more mysterious than we...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So when you say the graviton, would it be like the other particles, force carriers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: or can it be something much more mysterious?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: In some ways, yes, but in other ways, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It turns out that the graviton is also, if you look at Einstein's theory, he taught us

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: about this thing he calls space-time, which is...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: If you try to imagine it, you can sort of think of it as kind of a rubber surface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's one popular depiction of space-time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's not an accurate depiction because the only accuracy is actually in the calculus

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that he uses, but that's close enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So if you have a sheet of rubber, you can wave it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You can actually form a wave on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Space-time is enough like that so that when space-time oscillates, you create these waves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: These waves carry energy, we expect them to carry energy in quanta.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's what a graviton is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's a wave in space-time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so the fact that we have seen the waves with LIGO over the course of the last three

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: years and we've recently used gravitational wave observatories to watch colliding black

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: holes and neutron stars and all sorts of really cool stuff out there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So we know the waves exist, but in order to know that gravitons exist, you have to prove

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that these waves carry energy in energy packets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And that's what we don't have the technology to do yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And perhaps briefly jumping to a philosophical question, does it make sense to you that gravity

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: is so much weaker than the other forces?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You see, now you've touched on a very deep mystery about physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: There are a lot of such questions of physics about why things are as they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And as someone who believes that there are some things that certainly are coincidences,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: like you could ask the same question about, well, why are the planets at the orbits that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: they are around the sun?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The answer turns out there is no good reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's just an accident.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So there are things in nature that have that character and perhaps the strength of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: various forces is like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: On the other hand, we don't know that that's the case and there may be some deep reasons

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: about why the forces are ordered as they are, where the weakest force is gravity, the next

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: weakest force is the weak interaction, the weak nuclear force, then there's electromagnetism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: there's a strong force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: We don't really have a good understanding of why this is the ordering of the forces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Some of the fascinating work you've done is in the space of supersymmetry, symmetry in

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Can you describe, first of all, what is supersymmetry?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you remember the two buckets I told you about perhaps earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I said there are two buckets in our universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So now I want you to think about drawing a pie that has four quadrants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So I want you to cut the piece of pie in fourths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So in one quadrant, I'm going to put all the buckets that we talked about that are like

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: the electron in the quarks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: In a different quadrant, I am going to put all the force carriers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The other two quadrants are empty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Now I showed you a picture of that, you'd see a circle, there would be a bunch of stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: in one upper quadrant and stuff in others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And then I would ask you a question, does that look symmetrical to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And that's exactly right because we humans actually have a very deeply programmed sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: of symmetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's something that is part of that mystery of the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So how would you make it symmetrical?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: One way you could is by saying those two empty quadrants had things in them also.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And if you do that, that's supersymmetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So that's what I understood when I was a graduate student here at MIT in 1975 when the mathematics

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: of this was first being born.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Supersymmetry was actually born in the Ukraine in the late 60s, but we had this thing called

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: the Iron Curtain, so we Westerners didn't know about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But by the early 70s, independently, there were scientists in the West who had rediscovered

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: supersymmetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Bruno Zimino and Julius Vest were their names.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So this was around 71 or 72 when this happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I started graduate school in 73.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So around 74, 75, I was trying to figure out how to write a thesis so that I could become

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: a physicist the rest of my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I had a great advisor, Professor James Young, who had taught me a number of things about

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: electrons and weak forces and those sorts of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But I decided that if I was going to have an opportunity to maximize my chances of being

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: successful, I should strike it in a direction that other people were not studying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so as a consequence, I surveyed ideas that were being developed, and I came across

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: the idea of supersymmetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And the mathematics was so remarkable that it bowled me over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I actually have two undergraduate degrees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: My first undergraduate degree is actually mathematics, and my second is physics, even

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: though I always wanted to be a physicist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Plan A, which involved getting good grades, was mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I was a mathematics major thinking about graduate school, but my heart was in physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: If we could take a small digression, what's to you the most beautiful idea in mathematics

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: that you've encountered in this interplay between math and physics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's the idea of symmetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The fact that our innate sense of symmetry winds up aligning with just incredible mathematics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: to me, is the most beautiful thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's very strange but true that if symmetries were perfect, we would not exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So even though we have these very powerful ideas about balance in the universe in some

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: sense, it's only when you break those balances that you get creatures like humans and objects

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: like planets and stars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So although they are a scaffold for reality, they cannot be the entirety of reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So I'm kind of naturally attracted to parts of science and technology where symmetry plays

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: a dominant role.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And not just, I guess, symmetry, as you said, but the magic happens when you break the symmetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The magic happens when you break the symmetry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So diving right back in, you mentioned four quadrants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Two are filled with stuff we can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: We've measured.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And then there's crazy mathematical thing, ideas for filling the other two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The other two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What are those things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So earlier, the way I described these two buckets is I gave you a story that started

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: out by putting us in a dusty room with two flashlights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And I said, turn on your flashlight, I'll turn on mine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The beams will go through each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And the beams are composed of force carriers called photons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: They carry the electromagnetic force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And they pass right through each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So imagine looking at the mathematics of such an object, which you don't have to imagine

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: people like me do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you take that mathematics and then you ask yourself a question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: You see, mathematics is a palette.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's just like a musical composer is able to construct variations on a theme.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, a piece of mathematics in the hand of a physicist is something that we can construct

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: variations on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So even though the mathematics that Maxwell gave us about light, we know how to construct

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: variations on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And one of the variations you can construct is to say, suppose you have a force carrier

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: for electromagnetism that behaves like an electron in that it would bounce off of another

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: That's changing a mathematical term in an equation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So if you did that, you would have a force carrier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you would say first it belongs in this force carrying bucket, but it's got this

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: property of bouncing off like electrons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you say, well, gee, wait, no, that's not the right bucket.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you're forced to actually put it in one of these empty quadrants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So those sorts of things, basically we give them...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So the photon mathematically can be accompanied by a fotino.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It's the thing that carries a force but has the rule of bouncing off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: In a similar manner, you could start with an electron.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And you say, okay, so write down the mathematical electron.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I know how to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: A physicist named Dirac first told us how to do that back in the late 20s, early 30s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So take that mathematics and then you say, let me look at that mathematics and find out

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: what in the mathematics causes two electrons to bounce off of each other, even if I turn

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: off the electrical charge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So I could do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And now let me change that mathematical term.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So now I have something that carries electrical charge, but if you take two of them...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I'm sorry, if you turn their charges off, they'll pass through each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So that puts things in the other quadrant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And those things we tend to call...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: We put the S in front of their name.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So in the lower quadrant here, we have electrons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: In this now newly filled quadrant, we have electrons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And the quadrant over here, we had quarks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Over here we have squarks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So now we've got this balance pie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And that's basically what I understood as a graduate student in 1975 about this idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And what he came up with was a brilliant idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The way to solve it is that you take the data that you want to send, the ones in your strings

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: of ones and zeros, your favorite string, and then you dump more ones and zeros in, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: you dump them in in a particular pattern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And this particular pattern is what a Hamming code is all about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So it's an error correcting code because if the person at the other end knows what the

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: pattern is supposed to be, they can figure out when ones got changed to zeros, zeros

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: My mother died when I was 11 years old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I immediately knew what the end of the story was for all of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: As a consequence, I've never spent a lot of time thinking about death.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: People come in its own good time and to me, the job of every human is to make the best

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: and the most of the time that's given to us in order not for our own selfish gain, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: to try to make this place a better place for someone else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And on the why of life, why do you think we are?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I have no idea and I never even worried about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: For me, I have a local answer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The apparent why for me was because I'm supposed to do physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: But it's funny because there's so many other quantum mechanically speaking possibilities

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: in your life, such as being an astronaut, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: So you know about that, I see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, like Einstein and the vicissitudes that prevented the 1914 measurement of starlight

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: bending, the universe is constructed in such a way that I didn't become an astronaut, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: would have, for me, I would have faced the worst choice in my life, whether I would try

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: to become an astronaut or whether I would try to do theoretical physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Both of these dreams were born when I was four years old simultaneously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And so I can't imagine how difficult that decision would have been.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The universe helped you out on that one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Not only in that one, but in many ones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: It helped me out by allowing me to pick the right dad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Is there a day in your life you could relive because it made you truly happy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: What day would that be if you could just look back?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Being a theoretical physicist is like having Christmas every day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: I have lots of joy in my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The moments of invention, the moments of ideas, revelation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: The only thing that exceeds them are some family experiences like when my kids were

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: born and that kind of stuff, but they're pretty high up there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Well, I don't see a better way to end it, Jim.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Thank you so much, it was a huge honor talking today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: This worked out better than I thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Glad to hear it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation with S. James Gates Jr.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And thank you to our presenting sponsor, Cash App.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: on Patreon, or connect with me on Twitter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: And now, let me leave you with some words of wisdom from the great Albert Einstein for

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: the rebels among us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jim Gates: Supersymmetry, String Theory and Proving Einstein Right | Lex Fridman Podcast #60

body.input: Unthinking respect for authority is the greatest enemy of truth.
